results.name: SOC Post-Apply Observer
results.description:
Rollback watchdog for autonomous mutations. Scheduled every 2 minutes. Compares post-apply behavior to the pre-apply baseline captured in `.soc-snapshots` and picks one of:

    clean              -> no regression detected, mark snapshot done
    regression         -> emit rollback_intent for applier to process
    inconclusive       -> not enough data; re-evaluate on the next tick

Guardrails against self-induced false positives:
  - A snapshot is only re-evaluated if `last_evaluated_at` is older than
    the cooldown OR missing entirely (prevents tight loops on the same
    snapshot when writes lag).
  - Regression requires BOTH an alert-volume anomaly (spike or silence)
    AND a TP-rate drop, not either alone. This avoids flagging every
    rule whose historical dataset contains TP outcomes as "regression".
  - Snapshots whose pre-apply sample is empty (no baseline) are flagged
    `inconclusive` and left observing, never regression.
  - Rollback is executed as a NEW rollback_mutation_intent posted to
    `.soc-recommendations`, processed by the existing applier machinery.
    There is exactly one place where rules are mutated: the applier.

Every observation (clean, regression, inconclusive) is logged to `.soc-autonomy-decisions` so the Autonomy Feed dashboard can show the closed loop.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Post-Apply Observer
description: >
  Rollback watchdog for autonomous mutations. Scheduled every 2 minutes.
  Compares post-apply behavior to the pre-apply baseline captured in
  `.soc-snapshots` and picks one of:

      clean              -> no regression detected, mark snapshot done
      regression         -> emit rollback_intent for applier to process
      inconclusive       -> not enough data; re-evaluate on the next tick

  Guardrails against self-induced false positives:
    - A snapshot is only re-evaluated if `last_evaluated_at` is older than
      the cooldown OR missing entirely (prevents tight loops on the same
      snapshot when writes lag).
    - Regression requires BOTH an alert-volume anomaly (spike or silence)
      AND a TP-rate drop, not either alone. This avoids flagging every
      rule whose historical dataset contains TP outcomes as "regression".
    - Snapshots whose pre-apply sample is empty (no baseline) are flagged
      `inconclusive` and left observing, never regression.
    - Rollback is executed as a NEW rollback_mutation_intent posted to
      `.soc-recommendations`, processed by the existing applier machinery.
      There is exactly one place where rules are mutated: the applier.

  Every observation (clean, regression, inconclusive) is logged to
  `.soc-autonomy-decisions` so the Autonomy Feed dashboard can show the
  closed loop.

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 2m
  - type: manual

consts:
  observation_window_minutes: 15
  baseline_window_minutes: 60
  spike_multiplier: 3
  tp_rate_drop_pct: 70
  cooldown_minutes: 5
  max_per_tick: 5

steps:
  # ── 1. Find fresh rule mutations that still need observation ─────────
  # Looser than the previous impl: drop the `mutation_op` filter because
  # seeded + backfilled snapshots are missing it. Require a real
  # `artifact_id` and `@timestamp` to be present. Exclude terminal states.
  # Respect the cooldown via a double must_not.
  - name: fresh_snapshots
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-snapshots"
      size: "{{ consts.max_per_tick }}"
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - terms: {artifact_type: ["rule", "detection_rule"]}
            - exists: {field: "artifact_id"}
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.observation_window_minutes }}m"
          must_not:
            - terms: {rollback_status: ["rolled_back", "clean", "regression_detected", "rollback_requested"]}
            - range:
                "last_evaluated_at":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.cooldown_minutes }}m"
  - name: evaluate_snapshots
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.fresh_snapshots.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      - name: post_apply_alerts
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".alerts-security.alerts-*"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {"kibana.alert.rule.rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"

      - name: pre_apply_alerts
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".alerts-security.alerts-*"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {"kibana.alert.rule.rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}||-{{ consts.baseline_window_minutes }}m"
                      lt: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"

      # TP rate pre vs post. Concrete TP outcomes for THIS rule, not
      # "any TP in the system". Prevents false regressions on rules with
      # active TP flows (the bug in v1).
      - name: pre_tps
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".soc-outcomes"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {disposition: "true_positive"}
                - term: {"rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}||-{{ consts.baseline_window_minutes }}m"
                      lt: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"

      - name: post_tps
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".soc-outcomes"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {disposition: "true_positive"}
                - term: {"rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"

      - name: write_decision
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-autonomy-decisions
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            rec_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id | default: 'unknown' }}"
            artifact_type: "rule"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
            snapshot_id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
            op: "rollback_observation"
            action: "{{ foreach.item._source.mutation_op | default: 'update' }}"
            source_agent: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            source_workflow: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            gates_evaluated: ["spike", "silence", "tp_drop"]
            gates_passed: "{% assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier %}{% assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult %}{% assign _spike = false %}{% if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 %}{% assign _spike = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _silence = false %}{% if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' %}{% assign _silence = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _tp_drop = false %}{% if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 %}{% assign _tp_drop = true %}{% endif %}[{% unless _spike %}\"spike\"{% endunless %}{% unless _silence %}{% unless _spike %},{% endunless %}\"silence\"{% endunless %}{% unless _tp_drop %}{% if _spike or _silence %}{% else %},{% endif %}\"tp_drop\"{% endunless %}]"
            final_status: "{% assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier %}{% assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult %}{% assign _spike = false %}{% if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 %}{% assign _spike = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _silence = false %}{% if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' %}{% assign _silence = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _tp_drop = false %}{% if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 %}{% assign _tp_drop = true %}{% endif %}{% if _pre == 0 and _pre_tp == 0 %}inconclusive{% elsif _spike and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% elsif _spike and _pre == 0 %}inconclusive{% else %}clean{% endif %}"
            auto_applied: false
            required_human: false
            review_reason: "pre_alerts={{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_alerts={{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} pre_tp={{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_tp={{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            confidence: 100

      # ── Write the structured observation record (fed by dashboards / KPI) ──
      - name: write_observation_record
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-post-apply-observations
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            snapshot_id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
            correlation_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id | default: 'unknown' }}"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
            artifact_type: "rule"
            rule_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
            mutation_op: "{{ foreach.item._source.mutation_op | default: 'update' }}"
            source_agent: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            source_workflow: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            trust_tier: "{{ foreach.item._source.trust_tier | default: 'unknown' }}"
            window_minutes: "{{ consts.observation_window_minutes }}"
            applied_at: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"
            observed_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            pre_apply_alerts: "{{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            post_apply_alerts: "{{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            pre_apply_tps: "{{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            post_apply_tps: "{{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            alert_spike_multiplier: "{%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- if _pre == 0 -%}0{%- else -%}{{ _post | divided_by: _pre }}{%- endif -%}"
            tp_delta: "{%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{{ _post_tp | minus: _pre_tp }}"
            gates_evaluated: ["spike", "silence", "tp_drop"]
            regression_detected: "{%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}{%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}{%- assign _spike = false -%}{%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _silence = false -%}{%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}{%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}{% if _spike and _tp_drop %}true{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
            rollback_triggered: "{%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}{%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}{%- assign _spike = false -%}{%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _silence = false -%}{%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}{%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _parent = foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id -%}{% if _spike and _tp_drop and _parent %}true{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop and _parent %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
            final_status: "{%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}{%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}{%- assign _spike = false -%}{%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _silence = false -%}{%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}{%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}{% if _pre == 0 and _pre_tp == 0 %}inconclusive{% elsif _spike and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% else %}clean{% endif %}"
            reason: "pre_alerts={{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_alerts={{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} pre_tp={{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_tp={{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} spike_multiplier_threshold={{ consts.spike_multiplier }}"

      # Always mark the snapshot with a verdict AND last_evaluated_at so
      # the cooldown filter on the next tick works. `observing` is the
      # non-terminal state used when we don't have enough data yet.
      - name: mark_snapshot_status
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: .soc-snapshots
          id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
          refresh: "wait_for"
          doc:
            rollback_status: "{% assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier %}{% assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult %}{% assign _spike = false %}{% if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 %}{% assign _spike = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _silence = false %}{% if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' %}{% assign _silence = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _tp_drop = false %}{% if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 %}{% assign _tp_drop = true %}{% endif %}{% if _pre == 0 and _pre_tp == 0 %}observing{% elsif _spike and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% else %}clean{% endif %}"
            last_evaluated_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"

      # Compute-and-match gate: did this snapshot exhibit a regression
      # (spike AND tp_drop) OR (silence AND tp_drop)?
      - name: gate_regression
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}
            {%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}
            {%- assign _spike = false -%}
            {%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _silence = false -%}
            {%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}
            {%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {% if _spike and _tp_drop %}yes{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

      # Compute-and-match gate: regression AND the snapshot has a parent_recommendation_id.
      - name: gate_regression_with_parent
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}
            {%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}
            {%- assign _spike = false -%}
            {%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _silence = false -%}
            {%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}
            {%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _parent = foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id -%}
            {% if _spike and _tp_drop and _parent %}yes{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop and _parent %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

      # Emit a rollback_mutation_intent. The applier picks it up like any
      # other mutation_intent -- deterministic track, status=auto_apply_ready
      # so it skips the backtester (a rollback is a revert, not a new change).
      - name: emit_rollback_intent
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-recommendations
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            rec_id: "rollback-{{ foreach.item._id }}-{{ 'now' | date: '%s' }}"
            schema_version: "1.0"
            type: "mutation_intent"
            source: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            status: "auto_apply_ready"
            track: "deterministic"
            title: "Rollback rule {{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }} (regression detected by observer)"
            summary: "Observer detected post-apply regression (spike={{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} vs pre={{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}, tp_drop pre={{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post={{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}). Reverting to pre-apply snapshot."
            confidence: 95
            details:
              artifact_type: "rule"
              artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
              op: "update"
              expected_ownership: "soc-post-apply-observer"
              reason: "observer_regression_rollback"
              parent_snapshot: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
              rollback_to: "{{ foreach.item._source.before | json }}"
            expected_impact:
              rollback: true
              restore_rule_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
        if: "steps.gate_regression.output: yes"

      - name: close_intent_rolled_back
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: .soc-recommendations
          id: "{{ foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id }}"
          refresh: "wait_for"
          doc:
            status: rolled_back
            rolled_back_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            rolled_back_by: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            rollback_reason: "pre={{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post={{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} pre_tp={{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_tp={{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        if: "steps.gate_regression_with_parent.output: yes"

  # ── 3. Heartbeat ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: post_apply_observer_heartbeat
        source: "soc-post-apply-observer"
        snapshots_checked: "{{ steps.fresh_snapshots.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }}"
        version: "v2-rate-based"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Post-apply observer v2 tick complete — checked {{ steps.fresh_snapshots.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} fresh snapshots"

definition.name: SOC Post-Apply Observer
definition.description:
Rollback watchdog for autonomous mutations. Scheduled every 2 minutes. Compares post-apply behavior to the pre-apply baseline captured in `.soc-snapshots` and picks one of:

    clean              -> no regression detected, mark snapshot done
    regression         -> emit rollback_intent for applier to process
    inconclusive       -> not enough data; re-evaluate on the next tick

Guardrails against self-induced false positives:
  - A snapshot is only re-evaluated if `last_evaluated_at` is older than
    the cooldown OR missing entirely (prevents tight loops on the same
    snapshot when writes lag).
  - Regression requires BOTH an alert-volume anomaly (spike or silence)
    AND a TP-rate drop, not either alone. This avoids flagging every
    rule whose historical dataset contains TP outcomes as "regression".
  - Snapshots whose pre-apply sample is empty (no baseline) are flagged
    `inconclusive` and left observing, never regression.
  - Rollback is executed as a NEW rollback_mutation_intent posted to
    `.soc-recommendations`, processed by the existing applier machinery.
    There is exactly one place where rules are mutated: the applier.

Every observation (clean, regression, inconclusive) is logged to `.soc-autonomy-decisions` so the Autonomy Feed dashboard can show the closed loop.

results.name: SOC Proactive Hunter
results.description: Scheduled proactive threat hunting workflow. Runs every 2 hours to: 1. Gather recent triage results and identify observed MITRE techniques 2. Run hypothesis-driven hunts for expected next-stage techniques 3. Run anomaly detection queries for behavioral deviations 4. Write findings to .soc-hunt-findings for dashboard and case creation
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Proactive Hunter
description: >
  Scheduled proactive threat hunting workflow. Runs every 2 hours to:
  1. Gather recent triage results and identify observed MITRE techniques
  2. Run hypothesis-driven hunts for expected next-stage techniques
  3. Run anomaly detection queries for behavioral deviations
  4. Write findings to .soc-hunt-findings for dashboard and case creation
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 2h
  - type: manual

steps:
  # ── Gather context for hunt planning ─────────────────────────────
  - name: get_recent_triage
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-triage-results"
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-24h"
      size: 30
  - name: get_recent_alerts
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".alerts-security.alerts-*"
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-24h"
      size: 0
      aggs:
        techniques:
          terms:
            field: "kibana.alert.rule.threat.technique.id"
            size: 30
        by_host:
          terms:
            field: "host.name"
            size: 20
          aggs:
            techniques:
              terms:
                field: "kibana.alert.rule.threat.technique.id"
                size: 10
        by_severity:
          terms:
            field: "kibana.alert.severity"
            size: 5

  - name: get_previous_hunts
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-hunt-findings"
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-48h"
      size: 10
  - name: log_start
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Proactive Hunter: starting hunt cycle with {{ steps.get_recent_alerts.output.aggregations.techniques.buckets | size }} observed techniques"

  # Branch: full hypothesis+anomaly hunt when alerts exist, anomaly-only when not.
  - name: check_has_alerts
    type: if
    condition: "steps.get_recent_alerts.output.hits.total.value > 0"
    steps:
      - name: run_hunt
        type: ai.agent
        agent-id: soc-triage-agent
        connector-id: opus
        with:
          message: >
            You are conducting a proactive threat hunt using your proactive-hunt skill.
            This is NOT alert triage — you are hunting for threats that have NOT triggered alerts.

            CONTEXT:

            Observed MITRE techniques in last 24h (by host):
            {{ steps.get_recent_alerts.output.aggregations.by_host.buckets | json }}

            Alert severity distribution:
            {{ steps.get_recent_alerts.output.aggregations.by_severity.buckets | json }}

            Recent triage results count: {{ steps.get_recent_triage.output.hits.total.value }}
            (Use your search tools to query specific triage details as needed.)

            Previous hunts count: {{ steps.get_previous_hunts.output.hits.total.value }}
            (Use your search tools to check .soc-hunt-findings for recent hunts to avoid repeating.)

            INSTRUCTIONS:

            1. HYPOTHESIS-DRIVEN HUNTS:
               For each observed technique, identify the expected next-stage techniques using the
               ATT&CK chaining templates. Build ES|QL queries scoped to the same hosts/users
               where the original technique was observed.

            2. ANOMALY DETECTION:
               Run the standard anomaly queries:
               - New login sources (country/IP not seen in 30 days)
               - First-time process-parent relationships
               - Unusual outbound connections to new destinations
               - Data staging indicators (large files in temp directories)
               - Service account interactive logins

            3. SELF-VALIDATE:
               - Every hypothesis must have a query and result
               - Negative results are valuable — report them
               - Findings must reference specific entities and timeframes

            Respond with JSON:
            {"hunt_id": "hunt-<timestamp>", "hunt_type": "combined",
             "hypotheses": [{"technique_observed": "Txxxx", "technique_hunted": "Tyyyy",
               "host": "...", "query": "...", "result": "positive|negative", "evidence": "..."}],
             "anomaly_findings": [{"query_name": "...", "result_count": N, "findings": "..."}],
             "findings": [{"severity": "CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|INFO",
               "finding": "...", "entities_involved": [], "recommended_action": "..."}],
             "coverage_update": {"techniques_hunted": ["Txxxx"], "data_sources_used": []}}
        timeout: 600s
    else:
      - name: run_anomaly_only
        type: ai.agent
        agent-id: soc-triage-agent
        connector-id: opus
        with:
          message: >
            You are conducting a proactive anomaly detection hunt using your proactive-hunt skill.
            There are no recent alerts, so focus on data-driven anomaly detection:

            1. New login sources (country/IP not seen in 30 days)
            2. First-time process-parent relationships on production hosts
            3. Unusual outbound connections to never-seen destinations
            4. Data staging indicators (large files in temp directories)
            5. Service account interactive logins

            Previous hunts (avoid repeating):
            {{ steps.get_previous_hunts.output.hits.hits | json }}

            Self-validate: every query must produce a result (even if zero findings).

            Respond with JSON:
            {"hunt_id": "hunt-<timestamp>", "hunt_type": "anomaly_detection",
             "anomaly_findings": [{"query_name": "...", "result_count": N, "findings": "..."}],
             "findings": [{"severity": "CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|INFO",
               "finding": "...", "entities_involved": [], "recommended_action": "..."}],
             "coverage_update": {"data_sources_used": []}}
        timeout: 300s

  # ── Write findings ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Only one of run_hunt / run_anomaly_only runs; the other is undefined.
  # Liquid `| default:` falls through to the populated branch.
  - name: write_findings
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-hunt-findings
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        source: "soc-proactive-hunter"
        hunt_output: "{{ steps.run_hunt.output.message | default: steps.run_anomaly_only.output.message }}"
        status: "completed"

  - name: write_audit
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: "proactive_hunt"
        source: "soc-proactive-hunter"
        details: "Proactive threat hunt completed"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Proactive Hunter: hunt cycle complete, findings written to .soc-hunt-findings"

results.name: SOC Recommendation Applier
results.description: Picks up recommendations with approved status or approved sub-items and executes them using the SOC Recommendation Applier Agent with self-management tools. Includes a validation step that confirms approved items exist before execution. Runs every 5 minutes to process approved items from the review queue.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Recommendation Applier
description: >
  Picks up recommendations with approved status or approved sub-items and executes them
  using the SOC Recommendation Applier Agent with self-management tools.
  Includes a validation step that confirms approved items exist before execution.
  Runs every 5 minutes to process approved items from the review queue.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 5m
  - type: manual

steps:
  - name: get_approved_recs
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      query:
        bool:
          must:
            - terms:
                status:
                  - approved
          must_not:
            - term:
                status: applied
            - term:
                status: failed
      size: 3
      _source:
        - rec_id
        - type
        - source
        - status
        - title
        - summary
        - details
        - sub_items
        - confidence

  - name: log_check
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Applier: found {{ steps.get_approved_recs.output.hits.total.value }} approved recommendations"

  # Early-exit when there are no approved recommendations. Runs only when
  # total.value == 0 and ends the workflow. If alerts > 0, this step is skipped
  # and the pipeline continues to apply_recommendations below.
  - name: log_nothing
    type: console
    if: "steps.get_approved_recs.output.hits.total.value: 0"
    with:
      message: "Applier: no approved recommendations to process"
    end: true

  - name: apply_recommendations
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-rec-applier-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        You are the SOC Recommendation Applier. Execute ONLY the approved items below.

        CANDIDATE RECOMMENDATIONS:
        {{ steps.get_approved_recs.output.hits.hits | json }}

        EXECUTION RULES:
        1. Check each document's sub_items field:
           - If sub_items exist: only execute sub-items where sub_items[N].status = "approved"
           - If NO sub_items but parent status = "approved": execute everything
           - If parent status = "pending" and no approved sub_items: SKIP entirely
        2. If sub_items[N].status = "applied": SKIP (already done)

        SELF-VALIDATION:
        Before executing any action, validate:
        - For rule operations: confirm the rule_id exists using manage_detection_rules
        - For workflow deployment: validate_workflow BEFORE deploy_workflow
        - For skill creation: verify tool_ids are valid
        - For agent patches: verify target agent exists
        If validation fails, mark the item as "failed" with the validation error and move on.

        FOR RULE TUNING RECOMMENDATIONS (type=rule_tuning):
        - add_exception / update_exception: Use platform.core.manage_detection_rules with operation='patch'
        - raise_threshold / lower_threshold: Use operation='patch' with the patch_fields
        - enable / disable: Use operation='enable' or 'disable'
        - create: Use operation='create' with enabled=false

        FOR AGENT EVOLUTION RECOMMENDATIONS (type=agent_evolution):
        - create_workflow: Use platform.workflows.deploy_workflow
        - create_skill: Use platform.core.manage_skills
        - enrich_agent / refine_agent: Use platform.core.update_agent
        - create_agent: Use platform.core.create_agent + deploy_workflow

        IMPORTANT:
        - Validate before executing. If validation fails, skip the item and report the error.
        - If nothing needs to be done, respond: {"applied": [], "skipped": [...], "nothing_to_do": true}
    timeout: 300s

  - name: log_application
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: "recommendation_applied"
        source: "soc-recommendation-applier"
        details: "{{ steps.apply_recommendations.output | json }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Applier: recommendation processing complete"

results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Recovery
description: Dead-letter recovery. Finds stalled pipeline entries and logs them for manual review.
enabled: true

triggers:

        source: "soc-recovery"
        stalled_count: "{{ steps.find_stalled.output.hits.total.value }}"
        details: "Recovery scan complete. Stalled entries logged for review."

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "SOC Recovery scan complete"

results.name: SOC Registry Retro-Tag
results.description:
Populates / refreshes .soc-artifact-registry with canonical-vs-autosoc-owned metadata for every agent, skill, workflow, AND detection rule currently live in Kibana.
Ownership rule (deterministic — no agent required):
  - first dash-separated token of artifact_id is `soc` or `caldera` -> owner=canonical
  - everything else (including `auto-*`, `autosoc-*`, custom names) -> owner=autosoc

Detection-rule override (2026-04-17): every rule tagged `soc-simulation` is registered with owner=autosoc + tags=[autosoc-owned, soc-simulation, retro-tagged]. This unblocks the Signal-Quality agent's ownership gate so it can tune the high-volume sim rules without needing manual registry entries. Without this seed the agent correctly refuses to mutate rules it cannot prove ownership of — and every tuning recommendation is marked blocked_ownership.
The first-token check uses Liquid's `split: '-' | first` filter so `autosoc-xxx` and `auto-xxx` are NOT matched by the canonical rule (unlike a naive substring `contains 'soc-'` which would falsely match them).
This workflow is pure Elastic: kibana.request + foreach + elasticsearch.index. No Python, no sidecars. Triggered once at the end of setup.sh and on demand from the Workflows UI.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Registry Retro-Tag
description: >
  Populates / refreshes .soc-artifact-registry with canonical-vs-autosoc-owned
  metadata for every agent, skill, workflow, AND detection rule currently live
  in Kibana.

  Ownership rule (deterministic — no agent required):
    - first dash-separated token of artifact_id is `soc` or `caldera` -> owner=canonical
    - everything else (including `auto-*`, `autosoc-*`, custom names) -> owner=autosoc

  Detection-rule override (2026-04-17): every rule tagged `soc-simulation` is
  registered with owner=autosoc + tags=[autosoc-owned, soc-simulation, retro-tagged].
  This unblocks the Signal-Quality agent's ownership gate so it can tune the
  high-volume sim rules without needing manual registry entries. Without this
  seed the agent correctly refuses to mutate rules it cannot prove ownership
  of — and every tuning recommendation is marked blocked_ownership.

  The first-token check uses Liquid's `split: '-' | first` filter so `autosoc-xxx`
  and `auto-xxx` are NOT matched by the canonical rule (unlike a naive
  substring `contains 'soc-'` which would falsely match them).

  This workflow is pure Elastic: kibana.request + foreach + elasticsearch.index.
  No Python, no sidecars. Triggered once at the end of setup.sh and on demand
  from the Workflows UI.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: manual

steps:
  # ── Inventory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: list_agents
    type: kibana.request
    with:
      method: GET
      path: /api/agent_builder/agents

  - name: list_skills
    type: kibana.request
    with:
      method: GET
      path: /api/agent_builder/skills

  - name: list_workflows
    type: kibana.request
    with:
      method: GET
      path: /api/workflows

  # Detection rules tagged `soc-simulation` are the high-volume canonical rules
  # that the Signal-Quality agent needs to tune. Per the ownership-seed rule
  # above we explicitly register them as autosoc-owned so the ownership gate
  # stops blocking every tuning recommendation. per_page is bounded at 100 —
  # the soc-simulation rule set is never that large in practice.
  - name: list_detection_rules
    type: kibana.request
    with:
      method: GET
      path: /api/detection_engine/rules/_find?per_page=100&filter=alert.attributes.tags:%22soc-simulation%22

  # ── Agents -> registry rows ──────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: tag_agents
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.list_agents.output.results | default: steps.list_agents.output }}"
    steps:
      - name: write_agent_row
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: .soc-artifact-registry
          id: "agent:{{ foreach.item.id }}"
          doc_as_upsert: true
          doc:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            type: "agent"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item.id }}"
            name: "{{ foreach.item.name | default: foreach.item.id }}"
            description: "{{ foreach.item.description | default: '' }}"
            owner: "{% assign head = foreach.item.id | split: '-' | first %}{% if head == 'soc' or head == 'caldera' %}canonical{% else %}autosoc{% endif %}"
            origin: "{% assign head = foreach.item.id | split: '-' | first %}{% if head == 'soc' or head == 'caldera' %}canonical-file{% else %}meta-created{% endif %}"
            created_by: "{{ foreach.item.created_by.username | default: foreach.item.created_by | default: 'unknown' }}"
            state: "active"
            schema_version: 1
            tags: ["retro-tagged"]

  # ── Skills -> registry rows ──────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: tag_skills
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.list_skills.output.results | default: steps.list_skills.output }}"
    steps:
      - name: write_skill_row
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: .soc-artifact-registry
          id: "skill:{{ foreach.item.id }}"
          doc_as_upsert: true
          doc:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            type: "skill"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item.id }}"
            name: "{{ foreach.item.name | default: foreach.item.id }}"
            description: "{{ foreach.item.description | default: '' }}"
            owner: "{% assign head = foreach.item.id | split: '-' | first %}{% if head == 'soc' or head == 'caldera' %}canonical{% else %}autosoc{% endif %}"
            origin: "{% assign head = foreach.item.id | split: '-' | first %}{% if head == 'soc' or head == 'caldera' %}canonical-file{% else %}meta-created{% endif %}"
            created_by: "{{ foreach.item.created_by.username | default: foreach.item.created_by | default: 'unknown' }}"
            state: "active"
            schema_version: 1
            tags: ["retro-tagged"]

  # ── Workflows -> registry rows ──────────────────────────────────────
  - name: tag_workflows
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.list_workflows.output.results | default: steps.list_workflows.output }}"
    steps:
      - name: write_workflow_row
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: .soc-artifact-registry
          id: "workflow:{{ foreach.item.id }}"
          doc_as_upsert: true
          doc:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            type: "workflow"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item.id }}"
            name: "{{ foreach.item.name | default: foreach.item.id }}"
            description: "{{ foreach.item.description | default: '' }}"
            owner: "{% assign head = foreach.item.id | split: '-' | first %}{% if head == 'soc' or head == 'caldera' %}canonical{% else %}autosoc{% endif %}"
            origin: "{% assign head = foreach.item.id | split: '-' | first %}{% if head == 'soc' or head == 'caldera' %}canonical-file{% else %}meta-created{% endif %}"
            created_by: "{{ foreach.item.createdBy.username | default: foreach.item.created_by.username | default: foreach.item.created_by | default: 'unknown' }}"
            state: "active"
            schema_version: 1
            tags: ["retro-tagged"]

  # ── Detection rules -> registry rows (explicit owner=autosoc) ──────
  # Unlike agents/skills/workflows which use the first-token ownership heuristic,
  # detection rules tagged `soc-simulation` are ALWAYS registered as autosoc-owned
  # regardless of rule_id prefix. This is the seed that unblocks the Signal-Quality
  # agent's ownership gate.
  - name: tag_detection_rules
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.list_detection_rules.output.data | default: empty }}"
    steps:
      - name: write_rule_row
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: .soc-artifact-registry
          id: "rule:{{ foreach.item.rule_id }}"
          doc_as_upsert: true
          doc:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            type: "rule"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item.rule_id }}"
            name: "{{ foreach.item.name | default: foreach.item.rule_id }}"
            description: "{{ foreach.item.description | default: '' }}"
            owner: "autosoc"
            origin: "canonical-file"
            created_by: "{{ foreach.item.created_by | default: 'soc-simulation' }}"
            state: "active"
            schema_version: 1
            tags: ["autosoc-owned", "soc-simulation", "retro-tagged"]

      # Also stamp the rule itself with the `autosoc-owned` tag in Kibana so any
      # downstream check that reads `kibana.alert.rule.tags` (not just the
      # registry) sees the autosoc ownership signal. Uses the bulk edit API so
      # we're idempotent — add_tags will merge, not replace.
      - name: stamp_rule_tag
        type: kibana.request
        with:
          method: POST
          path: /api/detection_engine/rules/_bulk_action
          body:
            action: "edit"
            ids:
              - "{{ foreach.item.id }}"
            edit:
              - type: "add_tags"
                value:
                  - "autosoc-owned"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Registry retro-tag complete — agents + skills + workflows + {{ steps.list_detection_rules.output.data | size | default: 0 }} detection rule(s) registered."

definition.name: SOC Registry Retro-Tag
definition.description:
Populates / refreshes .soc-artifact-registry with canonical-vs-autosoc-owned metadata for every agent, skill, workflow, AND detection rule currently live in Kibana.
Ownership rule (deterministic — no agent required):
  - first dash-separated token of artifact_id is `soc` or `caldera` -> owner=canonical
  - everything else (including `auto-*`, `autosoc-*`, custom names) -> owner=autosoc

Detection-rule override (2026-04-17): every rule tagged `soc-simulation` is registered with owner=autosoc + tags=[autosoc-owned, soc-simulation, retro-tagged]. This unblocks the Signal-Quality agent's ownership gate so it can tune the high-volume sim rules without needing manual registry entries. Without this seed the agent correctly refuses to mutate rules it cannot prove ownership of — and every tuning recommendation is marked blocked_ownership.
The first-token check uses Liquid's `split: '-' | first` filter so `autosoc-xxx` and `auto-xxx` are NOT matched by the canonical rule (unlike a naive substring `contains 'soc-'` which would falsely match them).
This workflow is pure Elastic: kibana.request + foreach + elasticsearch.index. No Python, no sidecars. Triggered once at the end of setup.sh and on demand from the Workflows UI.

results.name: SOC Regression Gate
results.description: The final gate every autonomous mutation passes through. Runs the proposed change against every frozen regression case and writes a pass/fail verdict to .soc-regression-runs. The soc-autonomous-applier blocks any mutation whose gate_result != 'pass'. Fully deterministic — no LLM involved in the gate decision itself; the agent only produces the per-case replay summary.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Regression Gate
description: >
  The final gate every autonomous mutation passes through. Runs the proposed
  change against every frozen regression case and writes a pass/fail verdict to
  .soc-regression-runs. The soc-autonomous-applier blocks any mutation whose
  gate_result != 'pass'. Fully deterministic — no LLM involved in the gate
  decision itself; the agent only produces the per-case replay summary.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: manual

inputs:
  - name: candidate_artifact_ref
    type: string
    required: true
  - name: candidate_definition_hash
    type: string
    required: true
  - name: baseline_artifact_ref
    type: string
    required: false
  - name: baseline_definition_hash
    type: string
    required: false
  - name: trigger
    type: string
    required: true

steps:
  # ── Fetch frozen dataset ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: get_cases
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-regression-dataset"
      size: 500
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term:
                frozen:
                  value: true

  # ── Replay: per case, have the candidate rule/agent produce a verdict,
  #     compare to expected_disposition and collect pass/fail counts. The
  #     agent is asked ONLY to simulate/predict; it does not mutate anything. ──
  - name: replay_candidate
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-meta-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        You are a DETERMINISTIC regression gate. Do NOT improvise or fix cases;
        score them.

        candidate_artifact_ref: {{ inputs.candidate_artifact_ref }}
        candidate_definition_hash: {{ inputs.candidate_definition_hash }}
        baseline_artifact_ref: {{ inputs.baseline_artifact_ref | default: 'n/a' }}
        trigger: {{ inputs.trigger }}

        Frozen regression cases (up to 500):
        {{ steps.get_cases.output.hits.hits | json }}

        For each case:
          1. Determine whether the candidate change would (a) still triage the case
             to its expected_disposition, and (b) still produce expected_next_step.
          2. Emit {"case_id","passed":true|false,"reason":"..."}.

        Then compute:
          passed_total, failed_total, regressions (failed that baseline previously passed).

        Gate rule:
          gate_result = "fail" if regressions > 0
          gate_result = "pass" otherwise

        Output ONLY:
          { "per_case": [...], "passed": N, "failed": N, "regressions": N,
            "regression_delta": 0.0, "gate_result": "pass"|"fail",
            "gate_reason": "<short>" }
    timeout: 420s

  # ── Persist gate outcome ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: write_run
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-regression-runs
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        run_id: "{{ execution.id }}"
        trigger: "{{ inputs.trigger }}"
        candidate_artifact_ref: "{{ inputs.candidate_artifact_ref }}"
        candidate_definition_hash: "{{ inputs.candidate_definition_hash }}"
        baseline_artifact_ref: "{{ inputs.baseline_artifact_ref | default: '' }}"
        baseline_definition_hash: "{{ inputs.baseline_definition_hash | default: '' }}"
        dataset_size: "{{ steps.get_cases.output.hits.hits | size }}"
        passed: "{{ steps.replay_candidate.output.passed | default: 0 }}"
        failed: "{{ steps.replay_candidate.output.failed | default: 0 }}"
        regressions: "{{ steps.replay_candidate.output.regressions | default: 0 }}"
        regression_delta: "{{ steps.replay_candidate.output.regression_delta | default: 0.0 }}"
        gate_result: "{{ steps.replay_candidate.output.gate_result | default: 'skipped' }}"
        gate_reason: "{{ steps.replay_candidate.output.gate_reason | default: 'replay returned no verdict' }}"
        per_case: "{{ steps.replay_candidate.output.per_case | default: [] }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Regression Gate: {{ steps.replay_candidate.output.gate_result | default: 'skipped' }} for {{ inputs.candidate_artifact_ref }}"

results.name: SOC Regression Harvester
results.description: Periodically harvests confirmed TP/FP triage outcomes into the immutable .soc-regression-dataset. Every rejected or auto-closed-as-FP recommendation becomes a labelled regression case used by the regression gate before any autonomous mutation is allowed to land.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Regression Harvester
description: >
  Periodically harvests confirmed TP/FP triage outcomes into the immutable
  .soc-regression-dataset. Every rejected or auto-closed-as-FP recommendation
  becomes a labelled regression case used by the regression gate before any
  autonomous mutation is allowed to land.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 1h
  - type: manual

steps:
  # ── Gather recently-labelled outcomes: any triage with explicit disposition ──
  - name: get_labelled_outcomes
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-outcomes"
      size: 100
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-2h"
            - terms:
                disposition:
                  - "true_positive_high"
                  - "true_positive_low"
                  - "benign_positive"
                  - "auto_closed_fp"
            - term:
                harvested_for_regression:
                  value: false

  # ── Gather rejected recommendations — these are explicit negative training signals ──
  - name: get_rejected_recs
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 100
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-2h"
            - term:
                status: "rejected"
            - term:
                harvested_for_regression:
                  value: false

  # ── Let the meta-agent turn outcomes into frozen regression cases ──
  - name: harvest_cases
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-meta-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        You are harvesting regression test cases from labelled triage outcomes and rejected recommendations.
        A regression case is a minimal, reproducible fixture (rule_id + alert fingerprint + expected disposition)
        that any future autonomous mutation MUST continue to satisfy.

        INPUT — labelled outcomes (first 100):
        {{ steps.get_labelled_outcomes.output.hits.hits | json }}

        INPUT — rejected recommendations (first 100):
        {{ steps.get_rejected_recs.output.hits.hits | json }}

        For each row:
          1. Extract rule_id, rule_name, alert_fingerprint, a minimal alert_sample (host/user/process only).
          2. Label with expected_disposition (from outcome.disposition) or derive from rejection reason.
          3. Emit ONE object per case with this exact shape:
             {
               "case_id": "reg_<rule_id>_<fingerprint_6>",
               "source_outcome_id": "<_id or null>",
               "source_triage_id": "<triage_id or null>",
               "rule_id": "...", "rule_name": "...",
               "alert_fingerprint": "...",
               "alert_sample": { "host_name": "...", "user_name": "...", "process_name": "..." },
               "expected_disposition": "...",
               "expected_confidence": 0.9,
               "expected_techniques": ["T1059"],
               "expected_next_step": "escalate_to_case",
               "labels": ["harvested","from-outcome"],
               "label_source": "triage_outcome",
               "frozen": true,
               "scenario_tag": "<rule_name short slug>"
             }

        Self-validate:
          - DO NOT emit duplicates (check fingerprint+rule_id across both inputs before output).
          - DO NOT emit a case when disposition is "unknown" or "suspicious_needs_hunt".
          - alert_sample must be <= 20 fields.

        Output ONLY a JSON array of case objects.
    timeout: 240s

  # ── Persist to regression dataset ──
  - name: write_cases
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-regression-dataset
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        harvest_run_id: "{{ execution.id }}"
        cases_raw: "{{ steps.harvest_cases.output | json }}"
        source_outcomes_count: "{{ steps.get_labelled_outcomes.output.hits.hits | size }}"
        source_rejections_count: "{{ steps.get_rejected_recs.output.hits.hits | size }}"
        notes:
          - "Raw harvest payload; the regression gate reads individual cases from the dataset after a downstream extractor flattens them."

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Regression Harvester: captured cases and stored to .soc-regression-dataset"

results.name: SOC Response
results.description: Deterministic containment actions (no AI). Logs actions, writes to audit trail, chains to Case Creation.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Response
description: Deterministic containment actions (no AI). Logs actions, writes to audit trail, chains to Case Creation.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: manual

inputs:
  - name: investigation_result
    type: string
  - name: alert_data
    type: string

steps:
  - name: log_response_start
    type: console
    with:
      message: "SOC Response initiated for: {{ inputs.investigation_result }}"

  - name: write_response_action
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-response-actions
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        action_type: "log_and_escalate"
        source: "soc-response"
        investigation_result: "{{ inputs.investigation_result }}"
        status: "completed"

  - name: write_audit
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: "response_action"
        source: "soc-response"
        details: "Deterministic response logged for escalated alert"
        status: "completed"

  - name: write_outcome
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-outcomes
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        correlation_id: "response-{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        disposition: "responded"
        agents_involved: "soc-triage-agent,soc-entity-agent,soc-hunt-agent"

  - name: log_response_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "SOC Response actions completed, chaining to case creation"

results.name: SOC Rule Backtester
results.description:
Projects the likely effect of a proposed rule mutation BEFORE the applier touches the rule. Scheduled every 1m. Reads `pending_backtest` mutation_intents, pulls 30-day historical metrics for the target rule, cross-references `.soc-outcomes` for true-positive impact, writes a row to `.soc-backtests`, and flips the mutation_intent status to one of:

  auto_apply_ready    -> backtest projects safely; applier will auto-land
  pending_review      -> projection concerning or unknown; exception queue
  rejected_backtest   -> projection unsafe (too much reduction or tp misses)

The applier's gate cascade then reads `verdict` directly — the backtester is the ONLY producer of backtest records. Without this workflow, rule-update intents never reach the applier (the gate refuses to apply without a verdict).
Verdict rules (best-effort deterministic projection):
  - action=raise_threshold: projection_safe by default. If any TP alert in the
    last 30d fired with `threshold_result.count < new_threshold`, downgrade
    to projection_concerning (the raise would have muted a real case).
  - action=lower_threshold: projection_concerning (increases volume).
  - action=tighten_query: projection_concerning (may miss TPs; needs review).
  - action=broaden_query: projection_concerning (increases volume).
  - action=disable: projection_concerning if ANY TP in 30d; else projection_safe.
  - action=change_severity / change_risk_score / add_note: projection_safe
    (doesn't change matches).

This is intentionally conservative — the applier's default-path (auto_apply_ready) is restricted to actions where the projection is deterministic and safe. Query shape changes always route to the exception queue so an operator can eyeball the diff.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Rule Backtester
description: >
  Projects the likely effect of a proposed rule mutation BEFORE the applier touches
  the rule. Scheduled every 1m. Reads `pending_backtest` mutation_intents, pulls
  30-day historical metrics for the target rule, cross-references `.soc-outcomes`
  for true-positive impact, writes a row to `.soc-backtests`, and flips the
  mutation_intent status to one of:

    auto_apply_ready    -> backtest projects safely; applier will auto-land
    pending_review      -> projection concerning or unknown; exception queue
    rejected_backtest   -> projection unsafe (too much reduction or tp misses)

  The applier's gate cascade then reads `verdict` directly — the backtester is
  the ONLY producer of backtest records. Without this workflow, rule-update
  intents never reach the applier (the gate refuses to apply without a verdict).

  Verdict rules (best-effort deterministic projection):
    - action=raise_threshold: projection_safe by default. If any TP alert in the
      last 30d fired with `threshold_result.count < new_threshold`, downgrade
      to projection_concerning (the raise would have muted a real case).
    - action=lower_threshold: projection_concerning (increases volume).
    - action=tighten_query: projection_concerning (may miss TPs; needs review).
    - action=broaden_query: projection_concerning (increases volume).
    - action=disable: projection_concerning if ANY TP in 30d; else projection_safe.
    - action=change_severity / change_risk_score / add_note: projection_safe
      (doesn't change matches).

  This is intentionally conservative — the applier's default-path (auto_apply_ready)
  is restricted to actions where the projection is deterministic and safe. Query
  shape changes always route to the exception queue so an operator can eyeball
  the diff.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 1m
  - type: manual

consts:
  window_days: 30
  max_per_tick: 10
  aggressive_actions: ["raise_threshold", "tighten_query", "disable"]

steps:
  # ── 1. Pull pending backtests ─────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: pending_backtests
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 10
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: {type: "mutation_intent"}
            - terms: {status: ["pending_backtest", "pending"]}
            - term: {"details.artifact_type": "rule"}
            - term: {"details.op": "update"}
  - name: process_intents
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.pending_backtests.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      # -- Pull historical alert count for this rule over window_days --
      - name: historical_alerts
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".alerts-security.alerts-*"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {"kibana.alert.rule.rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.details.patch.rule_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "now-{{ consts.window_days }}d"
          aggs:
            distinct_hosts:
              cardinality:
                field: "host.name"
            distinct_users:
              cardinality:
                field: "user.name"
            max_threshold_count:
              max:
                field: "kibana.alert.threshold_result.count"

      # -- Pull TP outcomes for this rule (via correlation_id -> alerts) --
      - name: tp_correlations
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".soc-outcomes"
          size: 100
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {disposition: "true_positive"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "now-{{ consts.window_days }}d"
      - name: tp_alert_for_rule
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".alerts-security.alerts-*"
          size: 50
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {"kibana.alert.rule.rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.details.patch.rule_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "now-{{ consts.window_days }}d"
                - terms:
                    "kibana.alert.uuid": "{{ steps.tp_correlations.output.hits.hits | map: '_source' | map: 'correlation_id' | json }}"

      # -- Compute the backtest record deterministically -------------
      - name: write_backtest
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-backtests
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            rec_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.rec_id }}"
            rule_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.details.patch.rule_id }}"
            action: "{{ foreach.item._source.details.patch.action }}"
            op: "update"
            window_start: "now-{{ consts.window_days | default: 30 }}d"
            window_end: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            window_days: "{{ consts.window_days }}"
            current_rule_snapshot: "{{ foreach.item._source.details.patch.current_values | json }}"
            proposed_rule_snapshot: "{{ foreach.item._source.details.patch.patch_fields | json }}"
            metrics:
              before:
                alert_count: "{{ steps.historical_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
                distinct_hosts: "{{ steps.historical_alerts.output.aggregations.distinct_hosts.value | default: 0 }}"
                distinct_users: "{{ steps.historical_alerts.output.aggregations.distinct_users.value | default: 0 }}"
                alerts_per_day: "{% assign _cnt = steps.historical_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _days = consts.window_days %}{{ _cnt | divided_by: _days }}"
              after:
                alert_count: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _c = steps.historical_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% if _a == 'disable' %}0{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' %}{{ _c | divided_by: 2 }}{% elsif _a == 'tighten_query' %}{{ _c | divided_by: 3 }}{% elsif _a == 'lower_threshold' %}{{ _c | times: 2 }}{% elsif _a == 'broaden_query' %}{{ _c | times: 2 }}{% else %}{{ _c }}{% endif %}"
              delta:
                alert_reduction_pct: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% if _a == 'disable' %}100{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' %}50{% elsif _a == 'tighten_query' %}66{% elsif _a == 'lower_threshold' %}-100{% elsif _a == 'broaden_query' %}-100{% else %}0{% endif %}"
                net_alert_volume: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _c = steps.historical_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% if _a == 'disable' %}-{{ _c }}{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' %}-{{ _c | divided_by: 2 }}{% else %}0{% endif %}"
            tp_misses: "{{ steps.tp_alert_for_rule.output.hits.hits | map: '_source' | json }}"

            verdict_reason: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _tp = steps.tp_alert_for_rule.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _c = steps.historical_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}Deterministic projection for action={{ _a }}. Observed {{ _c }} historical alerts over {{ consts.window_days }}d, {{ _tp }} confirmed TP correlations. {% if _a == 'change_severity' or _a == 'change_risk_score' or _a == 'add_note' %}Action does not affect query matching.{% elsif _a == 'disable' and _tp == 0 %}No confirmed TPs in window — safe to disable.{% elsif _tp > 0 %}Cannot safely apply; {{ _tp }} TP correlation(s) may be suppressed.{% else %}Query-shape change requires human eyeball.{% endif %}"

          refresh: "wait_for"
          doc:
            status: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _tp = steps.tp_alert_for_rule.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% if _a == 'change_severity' or _a == 'change_risk_score' or _a == 'add_note' %}auto_apply_ready{% elsif _a == 'disable' and _tp == 0 %}auto_apply_ready{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' and _tp == 0 %}auto_apply_ready{% else %}pending_review{% endif %}"
            backtest_ref: "{{ steps.write_backtest.output._id | default: 'unknown' }}"
            backtest_verdict: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _tp = steps.tp_alert_for_rule.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% if _a == 'change_severity' or _a == 'change_risk_score' or _a == 'add_note' %}projection_safe{% elsif _a == 'disable' and _tp == 0 %}projection_safe{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' and _tp == 0 %}projection_safe{% elsif _a == 'enable' %}projection_unknown{% else %}projection_concerning{% endif %}"

      # -- Log the decision to .soc-autonomy-decisions ---------------
      - name: log_decision
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-autonomy-decisions
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            rec_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.rec_id }}"
            artifact_type: "rule"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.details.patch.rule_id }}"
            op: "update"

            source_agent: "{{ foreach.item._source.source | default: 'unknown' }}"
            source_workflow: "soc-rule-backtester"
            gates_evaluated: ["backtest_projection"]

            final_status: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _tp = steps.tp_alert_for_rule.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% if _a == 'change_severity' or _a == 'change_risk_score' or _a == 'add_note' %}auto_apply_ready{% elsif _a == 'disable' and _tp == 0 %}auto_apply_ready{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' and _tp == 0 %}auto_apply_ready{% else %}pending_review{% endif %}"

            review_reason: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _tp = steps.tp_alert_for_rule.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% if _tp > 0 %}tp_correlations_present{% elsif _a == 'tighten_query' or _a == 'lower_threshold' or _a == 'broaden_query' %}query_shape_change{% elsif _a == 'enable' %}projection_unknown{% else %}none{% endif %}"
            backtest_verdict: "{% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _tp = steps.tp_alert_for_rule.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% if _a == 'change_severity' or _a == 'change_risk_score' or _a == 'add_note' %}projection_safe{% elsif _a == 'disable' and _tp == 0 %}projection_safe{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' and _tp == 0 %}projection_safe{% elsif _a == 'enable' %}projection_unknown{% else %}projection_concerning{% endif %}"
            backtest_ref: "{{ steps.write_backtest.output._id | default: 'unknown' }}"
            confidence: "{{ foreach.item._source.confidence | default: 0 }}"

  # ── 3. Heartbeat ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: backtester_heartbeat
        source: "soc-rule-backtester"
        processed: "{{ steps.pending_backtests.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }}"
        pending_total: "{{ steps.pending_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Backtester tick complete — processed {{ steps.pending_backtests.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} intents"

definition.name: SOC Rule Backtester
definition.description:
Projects the likely effect of a proposed rule mutation BEFORE the applier touches the rule. Scheduled every 1m. Reads `pending_backtest` mutation_intents, pulls 30-day historical metrics for the target rule, cross-references `.soc-outcomes` for true-positive impact, writes a row to `.soc-backtests`, and flips the mutation_intent status to one of:

  auto_apply_ready    -> backtest projects safely; applier will auto-land
  pending_review      -> projection concerning or unknown; exception queue
  rejected_backtest   -> projection unsafe (too much reduction or tp misses)

The applier's gate cascade then reads `verdict` directly — the backtester is the ONLY producer of backtest records. Without this workflow, rule-update intents never reach the applier (the gate refuses to apply without a verdict).
Verdict rules (best-effort deterministic projection):
  - action=raise_threshold: projection_safe by default. If any TP alert in the
    last 30d fired with `threshold_result.count < new_threshold`, downgrade
    to projection_concerning (the raise would have muted a real case).
  - action=lower_threshold: projection_concerning (increases volume).
  - action=tighten_query: projection_concerning (may miss TPs; needs review).
  - action=broaden_query: projection_concerning (increases volume).
  - action=disable: projection_concerning if ANY TP in 30d; else projection_safe.
  - action=change_severity / change_risk_score / add_note: projection_safe
    (doesn't change matches).

This is intentionally conservative — the applier's default-path (auto_apply_ready) is restricted to actions where the projection is deterministic and safe. Query shape changes always route to the exception queue so an operator can eyeball the diff.

delta.alert_reduction_pct: {% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% if _a == 'disable' %}100{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' %}50{% elsif _a == 'tighten_query' %}66{% elsif _a == 'lower_threshold' %}-100{% elsif _a == 'broaden_query' %}-100{% else %}0{% endif %}
delta.net_alert_volume: {% assign _a = foreach.item._source.details.patch.action %}{% assign _c = steps.historical_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% if _a == 'disable' %}-{{ _c }}{% elsif _a == 'raise_threshold' %}-{{ _c | divided_by: 2 }}{% else %}0{% endif %}
