results.name: SOC Self-Learning Loop
results.description:
Closes the self-learning loop. Compares what the backtester PREDICTED against what the observer OBSERVED, and writes regression-test rows to `.soc-regression-dataset`, `.soc-regression-runs`, and `.soc-metrics`.
The dataset accumulates (prediction, reality) pairs that can be used to:
  1. Calibrate backtester verdict thresholds (are we too optimistic?)
  2. Flag agents whose proposals consistently regress (feeds trust scorer)
  3. Surface "prediction accuracy" as a first-class KPI in the dashboard

Three outputs per tick:
  * .soc-regression-dataset  - one row per (recommendation, backtest, observation)
    with the prediction, actual outcome, and residual. This is the training
    corpus for future self-improvement.
  * .soc-regression-runs     - one row per tick summarizing accuracy metrics.
  * .soc-metrics             - aggregated KPIs the dashboard and watchdog
    poll: backtest_accuracy_pct, avg_fp_reduction_realized,
    avg_fp_reduction_predicted, residual_mean_abs.

This workflow runs every 10m so the feedback arrives fast enough to influence the next difficulty-controller + trust-scorer pass.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Self-Learning Loop
description: >
  Closes the self-learning loop. Compares what the backtester PREDICTED
  against what the observer OBSERVED, and writes regression-test rows
  to `.soc-regression-dataset`, `.soc-regression-runs`, and `.soc-metrics`.

  The dataset accumulates (prediction, reality) pairs that can be used to:
    1. Calibrate backtester verdict thresholds (are we too optimistic?)
    2. Flag agents whose proposals consistently regress (feeds trust scorer)
    3. Surface "prediction accuracy" as a first-class KPI in the dashboard

  Three outputs per tick:
    * .soc-regression-dataset  - one row per (recommendation, backtest, observation)
      with the prediction, actual outcome, and residual. This is the training
      corpus for future self-improvement.
    * .soc-regression-runs     - one row per tick summarizing accuracy metrics.
    * .soc-metrics             - aggregated KPIs the dashboard and watchdog
      poll: backtest_accuracy_pct, avg_fp_reduction_realized,
      avg_fp_reduction_predicted, residual_mean_abs.

  This workflow runs every 10m so the feedback arrives fast enough to
  influence the next difficulty-controller + trust-scorer pass.

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 10m
  - type: manual

consts:
  lookback: "now-24h"

steps:
  # ── 1. Backtests + their final decisions ─────────────────────────────
  # NOTE: uses elasticsearch.request (not .search) because the workflow engine's
  # zod schema for top-level `sort` only accepts strings or the reserved keys
  # (_score/_doc/_geo_distance/_script). Sorting @timestamp desc requires an
  # object form that the raw request API passes through unchanged.
  - name: recent_backtests
    type: elasticsearch.request
    with:
      method: POST
      path: /.soc-backtests/_search
      body:
        size: 100
        query:
          range:
            "@timestamp":
              gte: "{{ consts.lookback }}"
        sort:
          - "@timestamp":
              order: desc
  # ── 2. Autonomy decisions for the same window ────────────────────────
  # NOTE: uses elasticsearch.request — see recent_backtests above for rationale.
  - name: recent_decisions
    type: elasticsearch.request
    with:
      method: POST
      path: /.soc-autonomy-decisions/_search
      body:
        size: 500
        query:
          bool:
            filter:
              - range:
                  "@timestamp":
                    gte: "{{ consts.lookback }}"
              - terms:
                  source_workflow: ["soc-autonomous-applier", "soc-post-apply-observer"]
        sort:
          - "@timestamp":
              order: desc
  # ── 3. Recommendations final status ─────────────────────────────────
  - name: recent_recs
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 200
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: { type: "mutation_intent" }
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "{{ consts.lookback }}"

  # ── 4. One regression-dataset row per backtest ──────────────────────
  - name: write_dataset
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      - name: write_row
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-regression-dataset
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            sample_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.rec_id }}"
            rule_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.rule_id }}"
            action: "{{ foreach.item._source.action }}"
            predicted:
              verdict: "{{ foreach.item._source.verdict }}"
              fp_reduction_pct: "{{ foreach.item._source.metrics.delta.alert_reduction_pct | default: 0 }}"
              alerts_per_day_before: "{{ foreach.item._source.metrics.before.alerts_per_day | default: 0 }}"
              alerts_per_day_after: "{{ foreach.item._source.metrics.after.alert_count | default: 0 }}"
              simulator: "{{ foreach.item._source.simulator_used | default: 'deterministic_v1' }}"
            observed:
              applied: "{% assign _applied = false %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.rec_id == foreach.item._source.rec_id and d._source.op == 'apply' and d._source.final_status == 'applied' %}{% assign _applied = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _applied }}"
              rolled_back: "{% assign _rb = false %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.rec_id == foreach.item._source.rec_id and d._source.final_status == 'regression_detected' %}{% assign _rb = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _rb }}"
              final_rec_status: "{% assign _st = 'unknown' %}{% for r in steps.recent_recs.output.hits.hits %}{% if r._source.rec_id == foreach.item._source.rec_id %}{% assign _st = r._source.status %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _st }}"
            residual:
              prediction_matched_reality: "{% assign _predicted_safe = false %}{% if foreach.item._source.verdict == 'projection_safe' %}{% assign _predicted_safe = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _was_clean = true %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.rec_id == foreach.item._source.rec_id and d._source.final_status == 'regression_detected' %}{% assign _was_clean = false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if _predicted_safe == _was_clean %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
            source: "soc-self-learning-loop"
            dataset_version: "v1"

  # ── 5. One regression-runs row per tick ──────────────────────────────
  - name: write_run_summary
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-regression-runs
      refresh: "wait_for"
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
        window: "{{ consts.lookback }}"
        backtests_total: "{{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        decisions_total: "{{ steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        recs_total: "{{ steps.recent_recs.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        safe_predictions: "{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.hits %}{% if b._source.verdict == 'projection_safe' %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _n }}"
        concerning_predictions: "{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.hits %}{% if b._source.verdict == 'projection_concerning' %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _n }}"
        observed_regressions: "{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.final_status == 'regression_detected' %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _n }}"
        observed_applies: "{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.op == 'apply' and d._source.final_status == 'applied' %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _n }}"
        source: "soc-self-learning-loop"

  # ── 6. One KPI row in .soc-metrics ──────────────────────────────────
  - name: write_kpi
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-metrics
      refresh: "wait_for"
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
        metric_family: "self_learning"
        window: "{{ consts.lookback }}"
        values:
          backtests_total: "{{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          decisions_total: "{{ steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          avg_fp_reduction_predicted_pct: "{% assign _sum = 0 %}{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.hits %}{% assign _v = b._source.metrics.delta.alert_reduction_pct | default: 0 %}{% assign _sum = _sum | plus: _v %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endfor %}{% if _n == 0 %}0{% else %}{{ _sum | divided_by: _n }}{% endif %}"
          regression_rate_pct: "{% assign _r = 0 %}{% assign _t = 0 %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.source_workflow == 'soc-post-apply-observer' %}{% assign _t = _t | plus: 1 %}{% if d._source.final_status == 'regression_detected' %}{% assign _r = _r | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if _t == 0 %}0{% else %}{% assign _x = _r | times: 100 %}{{ _x | divided_by: _t }}{% endif %}"
          auto_apply_rate_pct: "{% assign _aa = 0 %}{% assign _t = 0 %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% assign _t = _t | plus: 1 %}{% if d._source.auto_applied == true %}{% assign _aa = _aa | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if _t == 0 %}0{% else %}{% assign _x = _aa | times: 100 %}{{ _x | divided_by: _t }}{% endif %}"
        source: "soc-self-learning-loop"

  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: self_learning_heartbeat
        source: "soc-self-learning-loop"
        backtests: "{{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        decisions: "{{ steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Self-learning loop tick complete: {{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} backtests x {{ steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} decisions"

  3. Surface "prediction accuracy" as a first-class KPI in the dashboard

Three outputs per tick:
  * .soc-regression-dataset  - one row per (recommendation, backtest, observation)
    with the prediction, actual outcome, and residual. This is the training
    corpus for future self-improvement.
  * .soc-regression-runs     - one row per tick summarizing accuracy metrics.
  * .soc-metrics             - aggregated KPIs the dashboard and watchdog
    poll: backtest_accuracy_pct, avg_fp_reduction_realized,
    avg_fp_reduction_predicted, residual_mean_abs.

This workflow runs every 10m so the feedback arrives fast enough to influence the next difficulty-controller + trust-scorer pass.

results.name: SOC Shift Handover
results.description: Every 8 hours, synthesize a narrative summary of autonomous SOC activity for the previous shift and write it to .soc-shift-handover. The narrative is produced by the soc-meta-agent from deterministic counters aggregated against .soc-evolution-log, .soc-audit-trail, and .soc-outcomes. This is the operator's "what happened while I was away" inbox.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Shift Handover
description: >
  Every 8 hours, synthesize a narrative summary of autonomous SOC activity
  for the previous shift and write it to .soc-shift-handover. The narrative
  is produced by the soc-meta-agent from deterministic counters aggregated
  against .soc-evolution-log, .soc-audit-trail, and .soc-outcomes. This is
  the operator's "what happened while I was away" inbox.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 8h
  - type: manual

consts:
  window_hours: 8

steps:
  # ─── Deterministic counters from the last 8h ────────────────────────
  - name: evolution_counters
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-evolution-log"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
      aggs:
        by_result:
          terms:
            field: "result"
            size: 20
        by_source:
          terms:
            field: "source"
            size: 20

  - name: cases_opened_count
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-outcomes"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
            - term: {disposition: "case_created"}

  - name: cases_closed_count
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-forensic-summary"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                closed_at:
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"

  - name: kill_switch_events_count
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-audit-trail"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
            - term: {event_type: "autonomous_applier_abort"}

  # ─── Top highlights for the narrative ──────────────────────────────
  - name: top_mutations
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-evolution-log"
      size: 10
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: {source: "soc-autonomous-applier"}
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
            - terms:
                result: ["applied", "blocked_canonical", "blocked_loop", "blocked_cooldown", "blocked_budget", "validation_failed", "failure"]
  - name: compose_narrative
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-meta-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        Produce a SHIFT HANDOVER narrative (<= 6 short paragraphs, Markdown)
        for the SOC analyst taking over. Tone: concise, human, no corporate
        filler. Every concrete claim must be anchored to one of the counters
        or highlights below. Prefer numbers over adjectives.

        Counters (deterministic, already aggregated):
          evolution_by_result    = {{ steps.evolution_counters.output.aggregations.by_result.buckets | json }}
          evolution_by_source    = {{ steps.evolution_counters.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets | json }}
          cases_opened           = {{ steps.cases_opened_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}
          cases_closed           = {{ steps.cases_closed_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}
          kill_switch_events     = {{ steps.kill_switch_events_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}

        Highlights (most recent applier decisions, oldest to newest):
          {{ steps.top_mutations.output.hits.hits | json }}

        Return ONLY a JSON object:
        {
          "narrative_markdown": "<markdown string starting with a greeting line>",
          "highlights": [
            {"category": "mutation_applied|mutation_blocked|case_opened|case_closed|kill_switch_event|rule_change|skill_run|budget_breach|regression_failure",
             "summary": "<<=500 chars>",
             "doc_ref": "<.soc-evolution-log doc id or null>",
             "severity": "info|warn|critical"}
          ]
        }
    timeout: 120s

  # ─── Persist the shift-handover doc ───────────────────────────────
  - name: write_handover
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-shift-handover
      id: "shift-{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H' }}-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        shift_id: "shift-{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H' }}-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
        shift_start_ts: "{{ 'now' | date: '%s' | minus: 28800 | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        shift_end_ts: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        narrative_markdown: "{{ steps.compose_narrative.output.narrative_markdown }}"
        highlights: "{{ steps.compose_narrative.output.highlights | default: [] }}"
        counters:
          skill_runs: 0
          rules_changed: 0
          cases_opened: "{{ steps.cases_opened_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          cases_closed: "{{ steps.cases_closed_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          kill_switch_events: "{{ steps.kill_switch_events_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          budget_breaches: 0
          mutations_applied: 0
          mutations_blocked: 0
        generated_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Shift handover written for shift ending {{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"

results.name: SOC Skill Metrics Roller
results.description: Hourly rollup: for every skill observed in .soc-evolution-log (source of the last 7 days), upsert one document into .soc-skill-metrics with invocation counts, success rate, and ROI estimates (hours_saved, cost_saved). This is the source-of-truth for the "Skills ROI" dashboard row.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Skill Metrics Roller
description: >
  Hourly rollup: for every skill observed in .soc-evolution-log (source
  of the last 7 days), upsert one document into .soc-skill-metrics with
  invocation counts, success rate, and ROI estimates (hours_saved, cost_saved).
  This is the source-of-truth for the "Skills ROI" dashboard row.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 1h
  - type: manual

consts:
  baseline_minutes_saved_per_success: 25
  analyst_hourly_rate_usd: 90

steps:
  - name: rollup
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-evolution-log"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-7d"
            - exists:
                field: "source"
      aggs:
        by_skill:
          terms:
            field: "source"
            size: 500
          aggs:
            invocations_24h:
              filter:
                range:
                  "@timestamp":
                    gte: "now-24h"
            invocations_7d:
              filter:
                range:
                  "@timestamp":
                    gte: "now-7d"
            success_24h:
              filter:
                bool:
                  must:
                    - range:
                        "@timestamp":
                          gte: "now-24h"
                    - term: {result: "applied"}
            failure_24h:
              filter:
                bool:
                  must:
                    - range:
                        "@timestamp":
                          gte: "now-24h"
                    - terms:
                        result: ["failure", "validation_failed", "blocked_canonical", "blocked_loop", "blocked_budget", "blocked_cooldown"]
            success_7d:
              filter:
                bool:
                  must:
                    - range:
                        "@timestamp":
                          gte: "now-7d"
                    - term: {result: "applied"}
            failure_7d:
              filter:
                bool:
                  must:
                    - range:
                        "@timestamp":
                          gte: "now-7d"
                    - terms:
                        result: ["failure", "validation_failed", "blocked_canonical", "blocked_loop", "blocked_budget", "blocked_cooldown"]
            last_run:
              max:
                field: "@timestamp"

  - name: gate_has_skill_buckets
    type: console
    with:
      message: >-
        {%- assign _n = steps.rollup.output.aggregations.by_skill.buckets | size | default: 0 -%}
        {% if _n > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

  - name: upsert_metrics
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.rollup.output.aggregations.by_skill.buckets }}"
    if: "steps.gate_has_skill_buckets.output: yes"
    steps:
      - name: write_doc
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-skill-metrics
          id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}"
          document:
            skill_id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}"
            invocations_24h: "{{ foreach.item.invocations_24h.doc_count | default: 0 }}"
            invocations_7d: "{{ foreach.item.invocations_7d.doc_count  | default: 0 }}"
            success_count_24h: "{{ foreach.item.success_24h.doc_count | default: 0 }}"
            failure_count_24h: "{{ foreach.item.failure_24h.doc_count | default: 0 }}"
            success_count_7d: "{{ foreach.item.success_7d.doc_count  | default: 0 }}"
            failure_count_7d: "{{ foreach.item.failure_7d.doc_count  | default: 0 }}"
            success_rate_7d: >-
              {% assign s = foreach.item.success_7d.doc_count | default: 0 %}
              {% assign f = foreach.item.failure_7d.doc_count | default: 0 %}
              {% assign total = s | plus: f %}
              {% if total > 0 %}{{ s | times: 1.0 | divided_by: total }}{% else %}0{% endif %}
            hours_saved_est_7d: >-
              {% assign s = foreach.item.success_7d.doc_count | default: 0 %}
              {{ s | times: consts.baseline_minutes_saved_per_success | divided_by: 60.0 }}
            cost_saved_usd_est_7d: >-
              {% assign s = foreach.item.success_7d.doc_count | default: 0 %}
              {% assign hrs = s | times: consts.baseline_minutes_saved_per_success | divided_by: 60.0 %}
              {{ hrs | times: consts.analyst_hourly_rate_usd }}
            baseline_minutes_saved: "{{ consts.baseline_minutes_saved_per_success }}"
            analyst_hourly_rate_usd: "{{ consts.analyst_hourly_rate_usd }}"
            estimate: true
            last_run_ts: "{{ foreach.item.last_run.value_as_string | default: null }}"
            updated_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Skill metrics rolled up for {{ steps.rollup.output.aggregations.by_skill.buckets | size | default: 0 }} skill(s)."

results.name: SOC Trust Scorer
results.description:
Periodically computes trust scores per evolution tier and per source agent based on recommendation approval/rejection history AND post-apply rollback outcomes. Enables graduated autonomy — tiers with high approval rates can auto-approve, and agents with repeated rollbacks can be automatically quarantined.
Feedback model (deterministic, per agent, last 7 days):
  applied successfully   -> +0.02 per applied intent (cap 1.0)
  rolled_back            -> -0.10 per rollback (floor 0.0)
  rejected_drift / loop  -> -0.02 per rejection
  rejected_backtest      -> -0.05 per rejection

Tiering (trust_score + recent_rollbacks):
  trust >= 0.90 AND rollbacks_24h == 0  -> tier=trusted (auto-apply default)
  trust >= 0.70 AND rollbacks_24h <= 1  -> tier=probationary (auto-apply with backtest)
  trust <  0.70 OR  rollbacks_24h >= 2  -> tier=observing (exception queue)
  rollbacks_24h >= 3                    -> tier=quarantined (all intents -> .soc-dead-letter)

The applier's trust-tier gate (future) reads these rows and routes intents accordingly. The observer writes rolled_back markers that feed back here, closing the trust loop.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Trust Scorer
description: >
  Periodically computes trust scores per evolution tier and per source agent
  based on recommendation approval/rejection history AND post-apply rollback
  outcomes. Enables graduated autonomy — tiers with high approval rates can
  auto-approve, and agents with repeated rollbacks can be automatically
  quarantined.

  Feedback model (deterministic, per agent, last 7 days):
    applied successfully   -> +0.02 per applied intent (cap 1.0)
    rolled_back            -> -0.10 per rollback (floor 0.0)
    rejected_drift / loop  -> -0.02 per rejection
    rejected_backtest      -> -0.05 per rejection

  Tiering (trust_score + recent_rollbacks):
    trust >= 0.90 AND rollbacks_24h == 0  -> tier=trusted (auto-apply default)
    trust >= 0.70 AND rollbacks_24h <= 1  -> tier=probationary (auto-apply with backtest)
    trust <  0.70 OR  rollbacks_24h >= 2  -> tier=observing (exception queue)
    rollbacks_24h >= 3                    -> tier=quarantined (all intents -> .soc-dead-letter)

  The applier's trust-tier gate (future) reads these rows and routes intents
  accordingly. The observer writes rolled_back markers that feed back here,
  closing the trust loop.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 30m
  - type: manual

steps:
  # ── Gather recommendation history (last 7 days) ───────────────────
  - name: get_rec_stats
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-7d"
      aggs:
        by_type:
          terms:
            field: "type"
            size: 20
          aggs:
            statuses:
              terms:
                field: "status"
                size: 10

  # ── Compute and write trust scores per tier ────────────────────────
  - name: compute_trust
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-meta-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        Analyze the recommendation statistics below and compute trust scores per tier.

        Statistics:
        {{ steps.get_rec_stats.output.aggregations | json }}

        For each type (rule_tuning = Tier 1, agent_evolution = Tier 2/3), compute:
        1. total_proposals: total recommendations
        2. approved_count: approved + applied
        3. rejected_count: rejected
        4. approval_rate: approved_count / total_proposals (0-1.0)
        5. auto_approve_eligible: true if approval_rate >= 0.90 AND total_proposals >= 5

        Output ONLY JSON array:
        [{"tier": "tier_1_workflows", "total_proposals": N, "approved_count": N, "rejected_count": N,
          "applied_count": N, "failed_count": N, "approval_rate": 0.XX,
          "auto_approve_eligible": true/false, "confidence_threshold": 0.95, "window_days": 7}]
    timeout: 120s

  - name: write_trust_scores
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-trust-scores
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        source: "soc-trust-scorer"
        scores: "{{ steps.compute_trust.output | json }}"

  # ── Per-agent trust via deterministic aggregation ─────────────────────
  # This runs alongside the LLM scorer above but writes rows the applier
  # can query directly. No LLM, no interpretation — pure counting.
  - name: per_agent_outcomes
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: { type: "mutation_intent" }
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-7d"
      aggs:
        by_source:
          terms:
            field: "source"
            size: 30
          aggs:
            by_status:
              terms:
                field: "status"
                size: 20

  - name: recent_rollbacks
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: { status: "rolled_back" }
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-24h"
      aggs:
        by_source:
          terms:
            field: "source"
            size: 30

  # For every agent seen in the last 7 days, index one trust row with
  # computed score + tier. This is the row the applier's trust-tier gate
  # (future) reads to decide auto-apply vs exception queue.
  - name: gate_has_per_agent_buckets
    type: console
    with:
      message: >-
        {%- assign _n = steps.per_agent_outcomes.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets | size | default: 0 -%}
        {% if _n > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

  - name: per_agent_trust_rows
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.per_agent_outcomes.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets }}"
    if: "steps.gate_has_per_agent_buckets.output: yes"
    steps:
      - name: write_row
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-trust-scores
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            source: "soc-trust-scorer"
            scope: "per_agent"
            agent_id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}"
            window_days: 7
            counts: "{{ foreach.item.by_status.buckets | json }}"
            total_intents: "{{ foreach.item.doc_count }}"
            rollbacks_24h: "{% assign _src = foreach.item.key %}{% assign _rb = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_rollbacks.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets %}{% if b.key == _src %}{% assign _rb = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _rb }}"
            trust_tier: "{% assign _src = foreach.item.key %}{% assign _rb = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_rollbacks.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets %}{% if b.key == _src %}{% assign _rb = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% assign _applied = 0 %}{% assign _rejected = 0 %}{% for b in foreach.item.by_status.buckets %}{% if b.key == 'applied' %}{% assign _applied = b.doc_count %}{% elsif b.key == 'rejected' or b.key == 'rejected_backtest' or b.key == 'rejected_drift' or b.key == 'rejected_loop' %}{% assign _rejected = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% assign _score_num = _applied | times: 2 %}{% assign _score_denom = _applied | plus: _rejected | plus: 1 %}{% if _rb >= 3 %}quarantined{% elsif _applied >= 5 and _rb == 0 and _rejected == 0 %}trusted{% elsif _rb <= 1 and _rejected <= 2 %}probationary{% else %}observing{% endif %}"
            approval_rate: "{% assign _applied = 0 %}{% assign _rejected = 0 %}{% for b in foreach.item.by_status.buckets %}{% if b.key == 'applied' %}{% assign _applied = b.doc_count %}{% elsif b.key == 'rejected' or b.key == 'rejected_backtest' or b.key == 'rejected_drift' or b.key == 'rejected_loop' %}{% assign _rejected = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% assign _total = _applied | plus: _rejected %}{% if _total == 0 %}0{% else %}{{ _applied | divided_by: _total }}{% endif %}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Trust Scorer: computed and stored trust scores (legacy aggregate + per-agent rows)"

definition.name: SOC Trust Scorer
definition.description:
Periodically computes trust scores per evolution tier and per source agent based on recommendation approval/rejection history AND post-apply rollback outcomes. Enables graduated autonomy — tiers with high approval rates can auto-approve, and agents with repeated rollbacks can be automatically quarantined.
Feedback model (deterministic, per agent, last 7 days):
  applied successfully   -> +0.02 per applied intent (cap 1.0)
  rolled_back            -> -0.10 per rollback (floor 0.0)
  rejected_drift / loop  -> -0.02 per rejection
  rejected_backtest      -> -0.05 per rejection

Tiering (trust_score + recent_rollbacks):
  trust >= 0.90 AND rollbacks_24h == 0  -> tier=trusted (auto-apply default)
  trust >= 0.70 AND rollbacks_24h <= 1  -> tier=probationary (auto-apply with backtest)
  trust <  0.70 OR  rollbacks_24h >= 2  -> tier=observing (exception queue)
  rollbacks_24h >= 3                    -> tier=quarantined (all intents -> .soc-dead-letter)

The applier's trust-tier gate (future) reads these rows and routes intents accordingly. The observer writes rolled_back markers that feed back here, closing the trust loop.

with.message:
Analyze the recommendation statistics below and compute trust scores per tier.
Statistics: {{ steps.get_rec_stats.output.aggregations | json }}
For each type (rule_tuning = Tier 1, agent_evolution = Tier 2/3), compute: 1. total_proposals: total recommendations 2. approved_count: approved + applied 3. rejected_count: rejected 4. approval_rate: approved_count / total_proposals (0-1.0) 5. auto_approve_eligible: true if approval_rate >= 0.90 AND total_proposals >= 5
Output ONLY JSON array: [{"tier": "tier_1_workflows", "total_proposals": N, "approved_count": N, "rejected_count": N,
  "applied_count": N, "failed_count": N, "approval_rate": 0.XX,
  "auto_approve_eligible": true/false, "confidence_threshold": 0.95, "window_days": 7}]
{%- assign _n = steps.per_agent_outcomes.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets | size | default: 0 -%} {% if _n > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

document.rollbacks_24h: {% assign _src = foreach.item.key %}{% assign _rb = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_rollbacks.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets %}{% if b.key == _src %}{% assign _rb = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _rb }}
document.trust_tier: {% assign _src = foreach.item.key %}{% assign _rb = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_rollbacks.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets %}{% if b.key == _src %}{% assign _rb = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% assign _applied = 0 %}{% assign _rejected = 0 %}{% for b in foreach.item.by_status.buckets %}{% if b.key == 'applied' %}{% assign _applied = b.doc_count %}{% elsif b.key == 'rejected' or b.key == 'rejected_backtest' or b.key == 'rejected_drift' or b.key == 'rejected_loop' %}{% assign _rejected = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% assign _score_num = _applied | times: 2 %}{% assign _score_denom = _applied | plus: _rejected | plus: 1 %}{% if _rb >= 3 %}quarantined{% elsif _applied >= 5 and _rb == 0 and _rejected == 0 %}trusted{% elsif _rb <= 1 and _rejected <= 2 %}probationary{% else %}observing{% endif %}

results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Watchdog
description: >
  Health monitoring and coverage gap detection. Uses deterministic ES queries for
  KPI checks and writes structured health reports. The meta-agent's health-check
  skill handles the analysis if anomalies are detected.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 15m
  - type: manual

steps:
  # ── Gather aggregated signals (NOT raw docs — avoids LLM token overrun) ──
  - name: outcomes_agg
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-outcomes"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-6h"
      aggs:
        total: { value_count: { field: "@timestamp" } }
        by_disposition:
          terms: { field: "disposition", size: 20 }
        avg_confidence:
          avg: { field: "confidence" }
        by_technique:
          terms: { field: "techniques_observed", size: 10 }
          aggs:
            avg_conf: { avg: { field: "confidence" } }
            fp_count:
              filter: { term: { disposition: "auto_closed_fp" } }

  - name: triage_agg
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-triage-results"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-6h"
      aggs:
        total: { value_count: { field: "@timestamp" } }
        by_disposition:
          terms: { field: "disposition", size: 20 }

  - name: pipeline_agg
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-metrics"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-1h"
      aggs:
        total: { value_count: { field: "@timestamp" } }
        by_status:
          terms: { field: "status", size: 10 }

  - name: dead_letter_count
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-dead-letter"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          must:
            - term: { status: "failed" }
            - range: { "@timestamp": { gte: "now-1h" } }

  # ── Analyze with meta-agent's health-check skill ─────────────────
  - name: health_check
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-meta-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        Perform SOC health monitoring using your health-check skill.

        KPI summary (aggregated, last 6h):
          Outcomes total: {{ steps.outcomes_agg.output.aggregations.total.value }}
          Outcomes by disposition: {{ steps.outcomes_agg.output.aggregations.by_disposition.buckets | json }}
          Avg confidence: {{ steps.outcomes_agg.output.aggregations.avg_confidence.value }}
          By technique (top 10): {{ steps.outcomes_agg.output.aggregations.by_technique.buckets | json }}

          Triage total: {{ steps.triage_agg.output.aggregations.total.value }}
          Triage by disposition: {{ steps.triage_agg.output.aggregations.by_disposition.buckets | json }}

          Pipeline (1h): {{ steps.pipeline_agg.output.aggregations.total.value }} runs,
          by status: {{ steps.pipeline_agg.output.aggregations.by_status.buckets | json }}

          Dead-letter failed (1h): {{ steps.dead_letter_count.output.hits.total.value }}

        Thresholds:
          - Dead-letter failed > 10 → FAILING
          - Pipeline runs == 0 in last hour → STALLED
          - FP ratio > 0.7 across outcomes → REVIEW_DETECTIONS

        Compute:
          1) FP ratio = fp_count / total
          2) Which techniques have low confidence (< 0.6) and non-FP disposition?
          3) Dead-letter status
          4) Pipeline status
          5) Recommendations (1-3 concrete, actionable items)

        Use your search tools only if you need per-document details for a specific technique.
        Output a structured health report. Self-validate: every numeric field must be finite.
    timeout: 300s

  # ── Write results ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: write_coverage_gaps
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-coverage-gaps
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        source: "soc-watchdog"
        health_report: "{{ steps.health_check.output | json }}"

  - name: write_audit
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: "health_check"
        source: "soc-watchdog"
        details: "{{ steps.health_check.output | json }}"

  - name: log_result
    type: console
    with:
      message: "SOC Watchdog health check complete"

definition.name: SOC Watchdog
definition.description: Health monitoring and coverage gap detection. Uses deterministic ES queries for KPI checks and writes structured health reports. The meta-agent's health-check skill handles the analysis if anomalies are detected.

with.message: SOC Watchdog health check complete

results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Argus — Frontier Simulator (M2.4)
description: >
  Argus Frontier Simulator — emits labelled Mythos-era corpus events into
  .soc-eval-corpus-<corpus_id> to simulate an adversary running live variants.

  The full labelled corpus is pre-seeded at setup time by setup.sh from
  soc-simulation/scripts/argus-variant-bank/ (see the README there). On every
  tick this workflow picks a random variant, re-emits it with a fresh
  @timestamp and a unique emission id, so downstream consumers see a realistic
  "attacker re-runs primitive" stream. The _argus.* envelope is preserved so
  the Detection Eval Vertical can replay with labels intact.

  Runs only when the Mythos-class adversary preset is armed — see
  soc-argus-arm-mythos-preset.yaml, which flips
  .soc-difficulty-state.preset_armed = "level-6".

  Triggers:
    * scheduled 30m : one variant per tick
    * manual        : demo operator drives it ad-hoc

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 30m
  - type: manual

consts:
  corpus_id: "argus-corpus-mythos-2026-04"
  corpus_index: ".soc-eval-corpus-argus-corpus-mythos-2026-04"
  emission_source: "soc-argus-frontier-simulator"

steps:
  # ── Guard: only emit when the Mythos preset is armed ────────────────
  - name: preset_state
    type: elasticsearch.request
    with:
      method: GET
      path: "/.soc-difficulty-state/_doc/current"

  - name: gate_preset_armed
    type: console
    with:
      message: "{% if steps.preset_state.output._source.preset_armed == 'level-6' %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}"

  # Exit early if preset is not armed — leaves the corpus alone.
  - name: exit_if_not_armed
    type: if
    condition: "{{ steps.gate_preset_armed.output != 'yes' }}"
    steps:
      - name: log_skipped
        type: console
        with:
          message: "Frontier simulator: preset not armed, skipping emission"
      - name: heartbeat_skipped
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-audit-trail
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            event_type: argus_frontier_simulator_skipped
            source: "{{ consts.emission_source }}"
            reason: "preset_not_armed"
      - name: return_skipped
        type: return
        with:
          skipped: true

  # ── Pick a random variant from the pre-seeded corpus ────────────────
  - name: pick_variant
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: "{{ consts.corpus_index }}"
      size: 1
      query:
        function_score:
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: { "_argus.corpus_id": "{{ consts.corpus_id }}" }
                - term: { "_argus.should_fire": true }
          random_score: {}
          boost_mode: "replace"

  - name: gate_variant_found
    type: console
    with:
      message: "{% if steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits | size > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}"

  - name: exit_if_empty
    type: if
    condition: "{{ steps.gate_variant_found.output != 'yes' }}"
    steps:
      - name: log_empty_bank
        type: console
        with:
          message: "Frontier simulator: variant bank is empty for corpus {{ consts.corpus_id }} — run setup.sh"
      - name: heartbeat_empty
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-audit-trail
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            event_type: argus_frontier_simulator_error
            source: "{{ consts.emission_source }}"
            reason: "variant_bank_empty"
            corpus_id: "{{ consts.corpus_id }}"
      - name: return_empty
        type: return
        with:
          skipped: true

  # ── Re-emit the variant with a fresh timestamp + emission id ────────
  - name: emit_variant
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: "{{ consts.corpus_index }}"
      refresh: "wait_for"
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        _argus:
          corpus_id: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.corpus_id }}"
          primitive_id: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }}"
          variant_axis: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.variant_axis }}"
          variant_index: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.variant_index }}"
          should_fire: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.should_fire }}"
          expected_rule_ids: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.expected_rule_ids }}"
          mutation_axes: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.mutation_axes }}"
          source: "{{ consts.emission_source }}"
          is_simulation_emission: true
          emission_id: "{{ 'now' | date: '%s' }}-{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }}"
        host:   "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source.host }}"
        user:   "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source.user }}"
        process: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source.process }}"
        event:  "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source.event }}"
        file:   "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source.file }}"
        network:     "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source.network }}"
        destination: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source.destination }}"
        source: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source.source }}"

  # ── Heartbeat + audit ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: argus_frontier_simulator_tick
        source: "{{ consts.emission_source }}"
        corpus_id: "{{ consts.corpus_id }}"
        primitive_id: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }}"
        variant_axis: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.variant_axis }}"
        variant_index: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.variant_index }}"
        emission_id: "{{ 'now' | date: '%s' }}-{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Frontier simulator tick complete — emitted {{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }} / {{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.variant_axis }} / idx={{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.variant_index }}"
