results.description:
Closes the self-learning loop. Compares what the backtester PREDICTED against what the observer OBSERVED, and writes regression-test rows to `.soc-regression-dataset`, `.soc-regression-runs`, and `.soc-metrics`.
The dataset accumulates (prediction, reality) pairs that can be used to:
  1. Calibrate backtester verdict thresholds (are we too optimistic?)
  2. Flag agents whose proposals consistently regress (feeds trust scorer)
  3. Surface "prediction accuracy" as a first-class KPI in the dashboard

Three outputs per tick:
  * .soc-regression-dataset  - one row per (recommendation, backtest, observation)
    with the prediction, actual outcome, and residual. This is the training
    corpus for future self-improvement.
  * .soc-regression-runs     - one row per tick summarizing accuracy metrics.
  * .soc-metrics             - aggregated KPIs the dashboard and watchdog
    poll: backtest_accuracy_pct, avg_fp_reduction_realized,
    avg_fp_reduction_predicted, residual_mean_abs.

This workflow runs every 10m so the feedback arrives fast enough to influence the next difficulty-controller + trust-scorer pass.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Self-Learning Loop
description: >
  Closes the self-learning loop. Compares what the backtester PREDICTED
  against what the observer OBSERVED, and writes regression-test rows
  to `.soc-regression-dataset`, `.soc-regression-runs`, and `.soc-metrics`.

  The dataset accumulates (prediction, reality) pairs that can be used to:
    1. Calibrate backtester verdict thresholds (are we too optimistic?)
    2. Flag agents whose proposals consistently regress (feeds trust scorer)
    3. Surface "prediction accuracy" as a first-class KPI in the dashboard

  Three outputs per tick:
    * .soc-regression-dataset  - one row per (recommendation, backtest, observation)
      with the prediction, actual outcome, and residual. This is the training
      corpus for future self-improvement.
    * .soc-regression-runs     - one row per tick summarizing accuracy metrics.
    * .soc-metrics             - aggregated KPIs the dashboard and watchdog
      poll: backtest_accuracy_pct, avg_fp_reduction_realized,
      avg_fp_reduction_predicted, residual_mean_abs.

  This workflow runs every 10m so the feedback arrives fast enough to
  influence the next difficulty-controller + trust-scorer pass.

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 10m
  - type: manual

consts:
  lookback: "now-24h"

steps:
  # ── 1. Backtests + their final decisions ─────────────────────────────
  # NOTE: uses elasticsearch.request (not .search) because the workflow engine's
  # zod schema for top-level `sort` only accepts strings or the reserved keys
  # (_score/_doc/_geo_distance/_script). Sorting @timestamp desc requires an
  # object form that the raw request API passes through unchanged.
  - name: recent_backtests
    type: elasticsearch.request
    with:
      method: POST
      path: /.soc-backtests/_search
      body:
        size: 100
        query:
          range:
            "@timestamp":
              gte: "{{ consts.lookback }}"
        sort:
          - "@timestamp":
              order: desc
  # ── 2. Autonomy decisions for the same window ────────────────────────
  # NOTE: uses elasticsearch.request — see recent_backtests above for rationale.
  - name: recent_decisions
    type: elasticsearch.request
    with:
      method: POST
      path: /.soc-autonomy-decisions/_search
      body:
        size: 500
        query:
          bool:
            filter:
              - range:
                  "@timestamp":
                    gte: "{{ consts.lookback }}"
              - terms:
                  source_workflow: ["soc-autonomous-applier", "soc-post-apply-observer"]
        sort:
          - "@timestamp":
              order: desc
  # ── 3. Recommendations final status ─────────────────────────────────
  - name: recent_recs
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 200
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: { type: "mutation_intent" }
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "{{ consts.lookback }}"

  # ── 4. One regression-dataset row per backtest ──────────────────────
  - name: write_dataset
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      - name: write_row
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-regression-dataset
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            sample_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.rec_id }}"
            rule_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.rule_id }}"
            action: "{{ foreach.item._source.action }}"
            predicted:
              verdict: "{{ foreach.item._source.verdict }}"
              fp_reduction_pct: "{{ foreach.item._source.metrics.delta.alert_reduction_pct | default: 0 }}"
              alerts_per_day_before: "{{ foreach.item._source.metrics.before.alerts_per_day | default: 0 }}"
              alerts_per_day_after: "{{ foreach.item._source.metrics.after.alert_count | default: 0 }}"
              simulator: "{{ foreach.item._source.simulator_used | default: 'deterministic_v1' }}"
            observed:
              applied: "{% assign _applied = false %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.rec_id == foreach.item._source.rec_id and d._source.op == 'apply' and d._source.final_status == 'applied' %}{% assign _applied = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _applied }}"
              rolled_back: "{% assign _rb = false %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.rec_id == foreach.item._source.rec_id and d._source.final_status == 'regression_detected' %}{% assign _rb = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _rb }}"
              final_rec_status: "{% assign _st = 'unknown' %}{% for r in steps.recent_recs.output.hits.hits %}{% if r._source.rec_id == foreach.item._source.rec_id %}{% assign _st = r._source.status %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _st }}"
            residual:
              prediction_matched_reality: "{% assign _predicted_safe = false %}{% if foreach.item._source.verdict == 'projection_safe' %}{% assign _predicted_safe = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _was_clean = true %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.rec_id == foreach.item._source.rec_id and d._source.final_status == 'regression_detected' %}{% assign _was_clean = false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if _predicted_safe == _was_clean %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
            source: "soc-self-learning-loop"
            dataset_version: "v1"

  # ── 5. One regression-runs row per tick ──────────────────────────────
  - name: write_run_summary
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-regression-runs
      refresh: "wait_for"
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
        window: "{{ consts.lookback }}"
        backtests_total: "{{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        decisions_total: "{{ steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        recs_total: "{{ steps.recent_recs.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        safe_predictions: "{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.hits %}{% if b._source.verdict == 'projection_safe' %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _n }}"
        concerning_predictions: "{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.hits %}{% if b._source.verdict == 'projection_concerning' %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _n }}"
        observed_regressions: "{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.final_status == 'regression_detected' %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _n }}"
        observed_applies: "{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.op == 'apply' and d._source.final_status == 'applied' %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _n }}"
        source: "soc-self-learning-loop"

  # ── 6. One KPI row in .soc-metrics ──────────────────────────────────
  - name: write_kpi
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-metrics
      refresh: "wait_for"
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
        metric_family: "self_learning"
        window: "{{ consts.lookback }}"
        values:
          backtests_total: "{{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          decisions_total: "{{ steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          avg_fp_reduction_predicted_pct: "{% assign _sum = 0 %}{% assign _n = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.hits %}{% assign _v = b._source.metrics.delta.alert_reduction_pct | default: 0 %}{% assign _sum = _sum | plus: _v %}{% assign _n = _n | plus: 1 %}{% endfor %}{% if _n == 0 %}0{% else %}{{ _sum | divided_by: _n }}{% endif %}"
          regression_rate_pct: "{% assign _r = 0 %}{% assign _t = 0 %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% if d._source.source_workflow == 'soc-post-apply-observer' %}{% assign _t = _t | plus: 1 %}{% if d._source.final_status == 'regression_detected' %}{% assign _r = _r | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if _t == 0 %}0{% else %}{% assign _x = _r | times: 100 %}{{ _x | divided_by: _t }}{% endif %}"
          auto_apply_rate_pct: "{% assign _aa = 0 %}{% assign _t = 0 %}{% for d in steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.hits %}{% assign _t = _t | plus: 1 %}{% if d._source.auto_applied == true %}{% assign _aa = _aa | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if _t == 0 %}0{% else %}{% assign _x = _aa | times: 100 %}{{ _x | divided_by: _t }}{% endif %}"
        source: "soc-self-learning-loop"

  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: self_learning_heartbeat
        source: "soc-self-learning-loop"
        backtests: "{{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        decisions: "{{ steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Self-learning loop tick complete: {{ steps.recent_backtests.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} backtests x {{ steps.recent_decisions.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} decisions"

results.name: SOC Shift Handover
results.description: Every 8 hours, synthesize a narrative summary of autonomous SOC activity for the previous shift and write it to .soc-shift-handover. The narrative is produced by the soc-meta-agent from deterministic counters aggregated against .soc-evolution-log, .soc-audit-trail, and .soc-outcomes. This is the operator's "what happened while I was away" inbox.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Shift Handover
description: >
  Every 8 hours, synthesize a narrative summary of autonomous SOC activity
  for the previous shift and write it to .soc-shift-handover. The narrative
  is produced by the soc-meta-agent from deterministic counters aggregated
  against .soc-evolution-log, .soc-audit-trail, and .soc-outcomes. This is
  the operator's "what happened while I was away" inbox.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 8h
  - type: manual

consts:
  window_hours: 8

steps:
  # ─── Deterministic counters from the last 8h ────────────────────────
  - name: evolution_counters
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-evolution-log"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
      aggs:
        by_result:
          terms:
            field: "result"
            size: 20
        by_source:
          terms:
            field: "source"
            size: 20

  - name: cases_opened_count
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-outcomes"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
            - term: {disposition: "case_created"}

  - name: cases_closed_count
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-forensic-summary"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                closed_at:
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"

  - name: kill_switch_events_count
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-audit-trail"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
            - term: {event_type: "autonomous_applier_abort"}

  # ─── Top highlights for the narrative ──────────────────────────────
  - name: top_mutations
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-evolution-log"
      size: 10
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: {source: "soc-autonomous-applier"}
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
            - terms:
                result: ["applied", "blocked_canonical", "blocked_loop", "blocked_cooldown", "blocked_budget", "validation_failed", "failure"]
  - name: compose_narrative
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-meta-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        Produce a SHIFT HANDOVER narrative (<= 6 short paragraphs, Markdown)
        for the SOC analyst taking over. Tone: concise, human, no corporate
        filler. Every concrete claim must be anchored to one of the counters
        or highlights below. Prefer numbers over adjectives.

        Counters (deterministic, already aggregated):
          evolution_by_result    = {{ steps.evolution_counters.output.aggregations.by_result.buckets | json }}
          evolution_by_source    = {{ steps.evolution_counters.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets | json }}
          cases_opened           = {{ steps.cases_opened_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}
          cases_closed           = {{ steps.cases_closed_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}
          kill_switch_events     = {{ steps.kill_switch_events_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}

        Highlights (most recent applier decisions, oldest to newest):
          {{ steps.top_mutations.output.hits.hits | json }}

        Return ONLY a JSON object:
        {
          "narrative_markdown": "<markdown string starting with a greeting line>",
          "highlights": [
            {"category": "mutation_applied|mutation_blocked|case_opened|case_closed|kill_switch_event|rule_change|skill_run|budget_breach|regression_failure",
             "summary": "<<=500 chars>",
             "doc_ref": "<.soc-evolution-log doc id or null>",
             "severity": "info|warn|critical"}
          ]
        }
    timeout: 120s

  # ─── Persist the shift-handover doc ───────────────────────────────
  - name: write_handover
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-shift-handover
      id: "shift-{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H' }}-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        shift_id: "shift-{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H' }}-{{ consts.window_hours }}h"
        shift_start_ts: "{{ 'now' | date: '%s' | minus: 28800 | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        shift_end_ts: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        narrative_markdown: "{{ steps.compose_narrative.output.narrative_markdown }}"
        highlights: "{{ steps.compose_narrative.output.highlights | default: [] }}"
        counters:
          skill_runs: 0
          rules_changed: 0
          cases_opened: "{{ steps.cases_opened_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          cases_closed: "{{ steps.cases_closed_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          kill_switch_events: "{{ steps.kill_switch_events_count.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
          budget_breaches: 0
          mutations_applied: 0
          mutations_blocked: 0
        generated_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Shift handover written for shift ending {{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"

results.name: SOC Skill Metrics Roller
results.description: Hourly rollup: for every skill observed in .soc-evolution-log (source of the last 7 days), upsert one document into .soc-skill-metrics with invocation counts, success rate, and ROI estimates (hours_saved, cost_saved). This is the source-of-truth for the "Skills ROI" dashboard row.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Skill Metrics Roller
description: >
  Hourly rollup: for every skill observed in .soc-evolution-log (source
  of the last 7 days), upsert one document into .soc-skill-metrics with
  invocation counts, success rate, and ROI estimates (hours_saved, cost_saved).
  This is the source-of-truth for the "Skills ROI" dashboard row.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 1h
  - type: manual

consts:
  baseline_minutes_saved_per_success: 25
  analyst_hourly_rate_usd: 90

steps:
  - name: rollup
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-evolution-log"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-7d"
            - exists:
                field: "source"
      aggs:
        by_skill:
          terms:
            field: "source"
            size: 500
          aggs:
            invocations_24h:
              filter:
                range:
                  "@timestamp":
                    gte: "now-24h"
            invocations_7d:

            failure_24h:
              filter:
                bool:
                  must:
                    - range:
                        "@timestamp":
                          gte: "now-24h"
                    - terms:
                        result: ["failure", "validation_failed", "blocked_canonical", "blocked_loop", "blocked_budget", "blocked_cooldown"]
            success_7d:
              filter:

                    - range:

            failure_7d:
              filter:
                bool:
                  must:
                    - range:
                        "@timestamp":
                          gte: "now-7d"
                    - terms:
                        result: ["failure", "validation_failed", "blocked_canonical", "blocked_loop", "blocked_budget", "blocked_cooldown"]
            last_run:
              max:
                field: "@timestamp"

  - name: gate_has_skill_buckets
    type: console
    with:
      message: >-
        {%- assign _n = steps.rollup.output.aggregations.by_skill.buckets | size | default: 0 -%}
        {% if _n > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

  - name: upsert_metrics
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.rollup.output.aggregations.by_skill.buckets }}"
    if: "steps.gate_has_skill_buckets.output: yes"
    steps:
      - name: write_doc
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-skill-metrics
          id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}"
          document:
            skill_id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}"
            invocations_24h: "{{ foreach.item.invocations_24h.doc_count | default: 0 }}"
            invocations_7d: "{{ foreach.item.invocations_7d.doc_count  | default: 0 }}"
            success_count_24h: "{{ foreach.item.success_24h.doc_count | default: 0 }}"
            failure_count_24h: "{{ foreach.item.failure_24h.doc_count | default: 0 }}"
            success_count_7d: "{{ foreach.item.success_7d.doc_count  | default: 0 }}"
            failure_count_7d: "{{ foreach.item.failure_7d.doc_count  | default: 0 }}"
            success_rate_7d: >-
              {% assign s = foreach.item.success_7d.doc_count | default: 0 %}
              {% assign f = foreach.item.failure_7d.doc_count | default: 0 %}
              {% assign total = s | plus: f %}
              {% if total > 0 %}{{ s | times: 1.0 | divided_by: total }}{% else %}0{% endif %}
            hours_saved_est_7d: >-
              {% assign s = foreach.item.success_7d.doc_count | default: 0 %}
              {{ s | times: consts.baseline_minutes_saved_per_success | divided_by: 60.0 }}
            cost_saved_usd_est_7d: >-
              {% assign s = foreach.item.success_7d.doc_count | default: 0 %}
              {% assign hrs = s | times: consts.baseline_minutes_saved_per_success | divided_by: 60.0 %}
              {{ hrs | times: consts.analyst_hourly_rate_usd }}
            baseline_minutes_saved: "{{ consts.baseline_minutes_saved_per_success }}"
            analyst_hourly_rate_usd: "{{ consts.analyst_hourly_rate_usd }}"
            estimate: true
            last_run_ts: "{{ foreach.item.last_run.value_as_string | default: null }}"
            updated_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Skill metrics rolled up for {{ steps.rollup.output.aggregations.by_skill.buckets | size | default: 0 }} skill(s)."

results.name: SOC Triage
results.description: Unified triage workflow (alert-triggered). Runs classification, entity enrichment, and deep investigation in a single agent call. Writes the flattened triage verdict to `.soc-triage-results` and a derived outcome to `.soc-outcomes`. The disposition is derived from the agent output — it is NOT hardcoded.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Triage
description: >
  Unified triage workflow (alert-triggered). Runs classification, entity enrichment,
  and deep investigation in a single agent call. Writes the flattened triage verdict
  to `.soc-triage-results` and a derived outcome to `.soc-outcomes`. The disposition
  is derived from the agent output — it is NOT hardcoded.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: manual
  - type: alert

consts:
  run_id: "triage-{{ workflow.run_id | default: 'run' }}-{{ 'now' | date: '%s%3N' }}"
  now_iso: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"

steps:
  - name: log_alert
    type: console
    with:
      message: "SOC Triage received alert: {{ event | json }}"

  - name: triage
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-triage-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        Run the full triage pipeline on this security alert:
        Phase 1 — Classify as TRUE_POSITIVE, FALSE_POSITIVE, or SUSPICIOUS with confidence 0-100.
        Phase 2 — If confidence >= 40, enrich with entity context (risk scores, baselines, relationships).
        Phase 3 — If still ambiguous (confidence 40-69), conduct structured threat hunt.
        Phase 4 — If TRUE_POSITIVE or SUSPICIOUS with confidence >= 50, check for attack chain correlation
                   using security.attack_discovery_search.

        Produce multi-dimensional classification. Respond with STRICT JSON (no prose):

        {
          "classification":     "TRUE_POSITIVE" | "FALSE_POSITIVE" | "SUSPICIOUS",
          "confidence":         0-100,
          "disposition":        "TRUE_POSITIVE" | "BENIGN_TRUE_POSITIVE" | "FALSE_POSITIVE"
                               | "POLICY_VIOLATION" | "INCONCLUSIVE" | "DUPLICATE",
          "threat_category":    "commodity_malware" | "targeted_attack" | "insider_threat" | "misuse"
                               | "unauthorized_access" | "data_exfiltration" | "lateral_movement"
                               | "persistence" | "reconnaissance" | "unknown",
          "kill_chain_stage":   "reconnaissance" | "weaponization" | "delivery" | "exploitation"
                               | "installation" | "c2" | "actions_on_objectives" | "unknown",
          "business_impact":    { "data_at_risk": [...], "systems_at_risk": [...], "criticality": "low|medium|high|critical" },
          "recommended_action": "close_fp" | "open_case" | "enrich_only" | "escalate",
          "reasoning":          "<concise rationale>",
          "evidence":           [ { "summary": "...", "source_ref": "<doc id|query>", "confidence": 0.0-1.0 } ]
        }

        Self-validate: every field above MUST be populated. `disposition` MUST be one of the enumerated values
        (never "triaged" or other placeholders). `confidence` MUST be an integer 0-100.

        Alert data:
        {{ event | json }}
    timeout: 600s

  # Flatten the triage output at the top of the doc so dashboards and
  # aggregations don't have to reach into triage_output.* to get the verdict.
  # NOTE: Kibana's ai.agent step returns `{ message: "<raw-JSON-string>" }`; the
  # fields below live inside that string, not on `.output` directly. Every
  # reference uses `{% assign parsed = ... | json_parse %}` so the flat fields
  # are populated correctly instead of silently falling back to defaults.
  - name: write_triage_result
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-triage-results
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ consts.now_iso }}"
        run_id: "{{ consts.run_id }}"
        source: "soc-triage"
        stage: "unified_triage"
        pipeline: "soc-triage"
        alert_id: "{{ event.id | default: event._id | default: 'unknown' }}"
        rule_id: "{{ event['kibana.alert.rule.uuid'] | default: event.rule.id | default: null }}"
        rule_name: "{{ event['kibana.alert.rule.name'] | default: event.rule.name | default: null }}"
        classification: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.classification | default: 'SUSPICIOUS' }}"
        confidence: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.confidence | default: 0 }}"
        disposition: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.disposition | default: 'INCONCLUSIVE' }}"
        threat_category: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.threat_category | default: 'unknown' }}"
        kill_chain_stage: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.kill_chain_stage | default: 'unknown' }}"
        recommended_action: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.recommended_action | default: null }}"
        reasoning: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.reasoning | default: null }}"
        business_impact: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.business_impact | default: empty }}"
        evidence: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.evidence | default: empty }}"
        triage_output: "{{ steps.triage.output.message | json_parse | json }}"

  # Outcomes are the single source of truth for SLO/rollup dashboards. The
  # `disposition` on this doc is the agent's disposition — never "triaged".
  - name: write_outcome
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-outcomes
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ consts.now_iso }}"
        correlation_id: "{{ consts.run_id }}"
        pipeline: "soc-triage"
        stage: "unified_triage"
        agents_involved: ["soc-triage-agent"]
        classification: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.classification | default: 'SUSPICIOUS' }}"
        confidence: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.confidence | default: 0 }}"
        disposition: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.disposition | default: 'INCONCLUSIVE' }}"
        threat_category: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.threat_category | default: 'unknown' }}"
        kill_chain_stage: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.kill_chain_stage | default: 'unknown' }}"
        triage_result_ref: "{{ steps.write_triage_result.output._id | default: null }}"

  # Argus M2.5 — reasoning-trace governance. The `argus.*` block is the
  # standardised contract produced by `emitArgusSpanDoc` in
  # @kbn/argus-reasoning-traces; both the flat and nested views are populated
  # so governance dashboards can query by either shape. Confidence is
  # normalised from the 0-100 triage output onto the unit interval.
  - name: write_reasoning_trace
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-reasoning-trace
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ consts.now_iso }}"
        run_id: "{{ consts.run_id }}"
        agent_id: "soc-triage-agent"
        step_index: 0
        step_type: "run_summary"
        content: "Triage run for alert {{ event.id | default: 'unknown' }} → {% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}disposition={{ _pt.disposition | default: 'INCONCLUSIVE' }} confidence={{ _pt.confidence | default: 0 }}"
        run_summary:
          total_steps: 1
          tool_call_count: 0
          total_duration_ms: null
          final_status: "completed"
          final_output_ref: "{{ steps.write_triage_result.output._id | default: null }}"
        argus:
          agent:
            id: "soc-triage-agent"
            version: "argus-m2.5"
          decision:
            kind: "triage_verdict"
            id: "{{ consts.run_id }}"
            confidence: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.confidence | default: 0 | divided_by: 100.0 }}"
          actor:
            trust_tier: "scoped"
          correlation:
            alert_id: "{{ event.id | default: event._id | default: 'unknown' }}"
        attributes:
          argus.agent.id: "soc-triage-agent"
          argus.agent.version: "argus-m2.5"
          argus.decision.kind: "triage_verdict"
          argus.decision.id: "{{ consts.run_id }}"
          argus.decision.confidence: "{% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}{{ _pt.confidence | default: 0 | divided_by: 100.0 }}"
          argus.actor.trust_tier: "scoped"
          argus.correlation.alert_id: "{{ event.id | default: event._id | default: 'unknown' }}"

  - name: log_result
    type: console
    with:
      message: "SOC Triage complete → {% assign _pt = steps.triage.output.message | json_parse %}disposition={{ _pt.disposition | default: 'INCONCLUSIVE' }} confidence={{ _pt.confidence | default: 0 }} run_id={{ consts.run_id }}"

results.name: SOC Trust Scorer
results.description:
Periodically computes trust scores per evolution tier and per source agent based on recommendation approval/rejection history AND post-apply rollback outcomes. Enables graduated autonomy — tiers with high approval rates can auto-approve, and agents with repeated rollbacks can be automatically quarantined.
Feedback model (deterministic, per agent, last 7 days):
  applied successfully   -> +0.02 per applied intent (cap 1.0)
  rolled_back            -> -0.10 per rollback (floor 0.0)
  rejected_drift / loop  -> -0.02 per rejection
  rejected_backtest      -> -0.05 per rejection

Tiering (trust_score + recent_rollbacks):
  trust >= 0.90 AND rollbacks_24h == 0  -> tier=trusted (auto-apply default)
  trust >= 0.70 AND rollbacks_24h <= 1  -> tier=probationary (auto-apply with backtest)
  trust <  0.70 OR  rollbacks_24h >= 2  -> tier=observing (exception queue)
  rollbacks_24h >= 3                    -> tier=quarantined (all intents -> .soc-dead-letter)

The applier's trust-tier gate (future) reads these rows and routes intents accordingly. The observer writes rolled_back markers that feed back here, closing the trust loop.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Trust Scorer
description: >
  Periodically computes trust scores per evolution tier and per source agent
  based on recommendation approval/rejection history AND post-apply rollback
  outcomes. Enables graduated autonomy — tiers with high approval rates can
  auto-approve, and agents with repeated rollbacks can be automatically
  quarantined.

  Feedback model (deterministic, per agent, last 7 days):
    applied successfully   -> +0.02 per applied intent (cap 1.0)
    rolled_back            -> -0.10 per rollback (floor 0.0)
    rejected_drift / loop  -> -0.02 per rejection
    rejected_backtest      -> -0.05 per rejection

  Tiering (trust_score + recent_rollbacks):
    trust >= 0.90 AND rollbacks_24h == 0  -> tier=trusted (auto-apply default)
    trust >= 0.70 AND rollbacks_24h <= 1  -> tier=probationary (auto-apply with backtest)
    trust <  0.70 OR  rollbacks_24h >= 2  -> tier=observing (exception queue)
    rollbacks_24h >= 3                    -> tier=quarantined (all intents -> .soc-dead-letter)

  The applier's trust-tier gate (future) reads these rows and routes intents
  accordingly. The observer writes rolled_back markers that feed back here,
  closing the trust loop.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 30m
  - type: manual

steps:
  # ── Gather recommendation history (last 7 days) ───────────────────
  - name: get_rec_stats
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-7d"
      aggs:
        by_type:
          terms:
            field: "type"
            size: 20
          aggs:
            statuses:
              terms:
                field: "status"
                size: 10

  # ── Compute and write trust scores per tier ────────────────────────
  - name: compute_trust
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-meta-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        Analyze the recommendation statistics below and compute trust scores per tier.

        Statistics:
        {{ steps.get_rec_stats.output.aggregations | json }}

        For each type (rule_tuning = Tier 1, agent_evolution = Tier 2/3), compute:
        1. total_proposals: total recommendations
        2. approved_count: approved + applied
        3. rejected_count: rejected
        4. approval_rate: approved_count / total_proposals (0-1.0)
        5. auto_approve_eligible: true if approval_rate >= 0.90 AND total_proposals >= 5

        Output ONLY JSON array:
        [{"tier": "tier_1_workflows", "total_proposals": N, "approved_count": N, "rejected_count": N,
          "applied_count": N, "failed_count": N, "approval_rate": 0.XX,
          "auto_approve_eligible": true/false, "confidence_threshold": 0.95, "window_days": 7}]
    timeout: 120s

  - name: write_trust_scores
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-trust-scores
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        source: "soc-trust-scorer"
        scores: "{{ steps.compute_trust.output | json }}"

  # ── Per-agent trust via deterministic aggregation ─────────────────────
  # This runs alongside the LLM scorer above but writes rows the applier
  # can query directly. No LLM, no interpretation — pure counting.
  - name: per_agent_outcomes
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: { type: "mutation_intent" }
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-7d"
      aggs:
        by_source:
          terms:
            field: "source"
            size: 30
          aggs:
            by_status:
              terms:
                field: "status"
                size: 20

  - name: recent_rollbacks
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-recommendations"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: { status: "rolled_back" }
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-24h"
      aggs:
        by_source:
          terms:
            field: "source"
            size: 30

  # For every agent seen in the last 7 days, index one trust row with
  # computed score + tier. This is the row the applier's trust-tier gate
  # (future) reads to decide auto-apply vs exception queue.
  - name: gate_has_per_agent_buckets
    type: console
    with:
      message: >-
        {%- assign _n = steps.per_agent_outcomes.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets | size | default: 0 -%}
        {% if _n > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

  - name: per_agent_trust_rows
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.per_agent_outcomes.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets }}"
    if: "steps.gate_has_per_agent_buckets.output: yes"
    steps:
      - name: write_row
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-trust-scores
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            source: "soc-trust-scorer"
            scope: "per_agent"
            agent_id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}"
            window_days: 7
            counts: "{{ foreach.item.by_status.buckets | json }}"
            total_intents: "{{ foreach.item.doc_count }}"
            rollbacks_24h: "{% assign _src = foreach.item.key %}{% assign _rb = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_rollbacks.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets %}{% if b.key == _src %}{% assign _rb = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ _rb }}"
            trust_tier: "{% assign _src = foreach.item.key %}{% assign _rb = 0 %}{% for b in steps.recent_rollbacks.output.aggregations.by_source.buckets %}{% if b.key == _src %}{% assign _rb = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% assign _applied = 0 %}{% assign _rejected = 0 %}{% for b in foreach.item.by_status.buckets %}{% if b.key == 'applied' %}{% assign _applied = b.doc_count %}{% elsif b.key == 'rejected' or b.key == 'rejected_backtest' or b.key == 'rejected_drift' or b.key == 'rejected_loop' %}{% assign _rejected = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% assign _score_num = _applied | times: 2 %}{% assign _score_denom = _applied | plus: _rejected | plus: 1 %}{% if _rb >= 3 %}quarantined{% elsif _applied >= 5 and _rb == 0 and _rejected == 0 %}trusted{% elsif _rb <= 1 and _rejected <= 2 %}probationary{% else %}observing{% endif %}"
            approval_rate: "{% assign _applied = 0 %}{% assign _rejected = 0 %}{% for b in foreach.item.by_status.buckets %}{% if b.key == 'applied' %}{% assign _applied = b.doc_count %}{% elsif b.key == 'rejected' or b.key == 'rejected_backtest' or b.key == 'rejected_drift' or b.key == 'rejected_loop' %}{% assign _rejected = b.doc_count %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% assign _total = _applied | plus: _rejected %}{% if _total == 0 %}0{% else %}{{ _applied | divided_by: _total }}{% endif %}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Trust Scorer: computed and stored trust scores (legacy aggregate + per-agent rows)"

Enables graduated autonomy — tiers with high approval rates can auto-approve, and agents with repeated rollbacks can be automatically quarantined.
Feedback model (deterministic, per agent, last 7 days):
  applied successfully   -> +0.02 per applied intent (cap 1.0)
  rolled_back            -> -0.10 per rollback (floor 0.0)
  rejected_drift / loop  -> -0.02 per rejection
  rejected_backtest      -> -0.05 per rejection

Tiering (trust_score + recent_rollbacks):
  trust >= 0.90 AND rollbacks_24h == 0  -> tier=trusted (auto-apply default)
  trust >= 0.70 AND rollbacks_24h <= 1  -> tier=probationary (auto-apply with backtest)
  trust <  0.70 OR  rollbacks_24h >= 2  -> tier=observing (exception queue)
  rollbacks_24h >= 3                    -> tier=quarantined (all intents -> .soc-dead-letter)

The applier's trust-tier gate (future) reads these rows and routes intents accordingly. The observer writes rolled_back markers that feed back here, closing the trust loop.

results.name: SOC Watchdog
results.description: Health monitoring and coverage gap detection. Uses deterministic ES queries for KPI checks and writes structured health reports. The meta-agent's health-check skill handles the analysis if anomalies are detected.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Watchdog
description: >
  Health monitoring and coverage gap detection. Uses deterministic ES queries for
  KPI checks and writes structured health reports. The meta-agent's health-check
  skill handles the analysis if anomalies are detected.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 15m
  - type: manual

steps:
  # ── Gather aggregated signals (NOT raw docs — avoids LLM token overrun) ──
  - name: outcomes_agg
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-outcomes"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-6h"
      aggs:
        total: { value_count: { field: "@timestamp" } }
        by_disposition:
          terms: { field: "disposition", size: 20 }
        avg_confidence:
          avg: { field: "confidence" }
        by_technique:
          terms: { field: "techniques_observed", size: 10 }
          aggs:
            avg_conf: { avg: { field: "confidence" } }
            fp_count:
              filter: { term: { disposition: "auto_closed_fp" } }

  - name: triage_agg
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-triage-results"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-6h"
      aggs:
        total: { value_count: { field: "@timestamp" } }
        by_disposition:
          terms: { field: "disposition", size: 20 }

  - name: pipeline_agg
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-metrics"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-1h"
      aggs:
        total: { value_count: { field: "@timestamp" } }
        by_status:
          terms: { field: "status", size: 10 }

  - name: dead_letter_count
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-dead-letter"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          must:
            - term: { status: "failed" }
            - range: { "@timestamp": { gte: "now-1h" } }

  # ── Analyze with meta-agent's health-check skill ─────────────────
  - name: health_check
    type: ai.agent
    agent-id: soc-meta-agent
    connector-id: opus
    with:
      message: >
        Perform SOC health monitoring using your health-check skill.

        KPI summary (aggregated, last 6h):
          Outcomes total: {{ steps.outcomes_agg.output.aggregations.total.value }}
          Outcomes by disposition: {{ steps.outcomes_agg.output.aggregations.by_disposition.buckets | json }}
          Avg confidence: {{ steps.outcomes_agg.output.aggregations.avg_confidence.value }}
          By technique (top 10): {{ steps.outcomes_agg.output.aggregations.by_technique.buckets | json }}

          Triage total: {{ steps.triage_agg.output.aggregations.total.value }}
          Triage by disposition: {{ steps.triage_agg.output.aggregations.by_disposition.buckets | json }}

          Pipeline (1h): {{ steps.pipeline_agg.output.aggregations.total.value }} runs,
          by status: {{ steps.pipeline_agg.output.aggregations.by_status.buckets | json }}

          Dead-letter failed (1h): {{ steps.dead_letter_count.output.hits.total.value }}

        Thresholds:
          - Dead-letter failed > 10 → FAILING
          - Pipeline runs == 0 in last hour → STALLED
          - FP ratio > 0.7 across outcomes → REVIEW_DETECTIONS

        Compute:
          1) FP ratio = fp_count / total
          2) Which techniques have low confidence (< 0.6) and non-FP disposition?
          3) Dead-letter status
          4) Pipeline status
          5) Recommendations (1-3 concrete, actionable items)

        Use your search tools only if you need per-document details for a specific technique.
        Output a structured health report. Self-validate: every numeric field must be finite.
    timeout: 300s

  # ── Write results ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: write_coverage_gaps
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-coverage-gaps
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        source: "soc-watchdog"
        health_report: "{{ steps.health_check.output | json }}"

  - name: write_audit
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: "health_check"
        source: "soc-watchdog"
        details: "{{ steps.health_check.output | json }}"

  - name: log_result
    type: console
    with:
      message: "SOC Watchdog health check complete"

definition.name: SOC Watchdog
definition.description: Health monitoring and coverage gap detection. Uses deterministic ES queries for KPI checks and writes structured health reports. The meta-agent's health-check skill handles the analysis if anomalies are detected.

with.message: SOC Watchdog health check complete

results.name: SOC Post-Apply Observer
results.description:
Rollback watchdog for autonomous mutations. Scheduled every 2 minutes. Compares post-apply behavior to the pre-apply baseline captured in `.soc-snapshots` and picks one of:

    clean              -> no regression detected, mark snapshot done
    regression         -> emit rollback_intent for applier to process
    inconclusive       -> not enough data; re-evaluate on the next tick

Guardrails against self-induced false positives:
  - A snapshot is only re-evaluated if `last_evaluated_at` is older than
    the cooldown OR missing entirely (prevents tight loops on the same
    snapshot when writes lag).
  - Regression requires BOTH an alert-volume anomaly (spike or silence)
    AND a TP-rate drop, not either alone. This avoids flagging every
    rule whose historical dataset contains TP outcomes as "regression".
  - Snapshots whose pre-apply sample is empty (no baseline) are flagged
    `inconclusive` and left observing, never regression.
  - Rollback is executed as a NEW rollback_mutation_intent posted to
    `.soc-recommendations`, processed by the existing applier machinery.
    There is exactly one place where rules are mutated: the applier.

Every observation (clean, regression, inconclusive) is logged to `.soc-autonomy-decisions` so the Autonomy Feed dashboard can show the closed loop.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Post-Apply Observer
description: >
  Rollback watchdog for autonomous mutations. Scheduled every 2 minutes.
  Compares post-apply behavior to the pre-apply baseline captured in
  `.soc-snapshots` and picks one of:

      clean              -> no regression detected, mark snapshot done
      regression         -> emit rollback_intent for applier to process
      inconclusive       -> not enough data; re-evaluate on the next tick

  Guardrails against self-induced false positives:
    - A snapshot is only re-evaluated if `last_evaluated_at` is older than
      the cooldown OR missing entirely (prevents tight loops on the same
      snapshot when writes lag).
    - Regression requires BOTH an alert-volume anomaly (spike or silence)
      AND a TP-rate drop, not either alone. This avoids flagging every
      rule whose historical dataset contains TP outcomes as "regression".
    - Snapshots whose pre-apply sample is empty (no baseline) are flagged
      `inconclusive` and left observing, never regression.
    - Rollback is executed as a NEW rollback_mutation_intent posted to
      `.soc-recommendations`, processed by the existing applier machinery.
      There is exactly one place where rules are mutated: the applier.

  Every observation (clean, regression, inconclusive) is logged to
  `.soc-autonomy-decisions` so the Autonomy Feed dashboard can show the
  closed loop.

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 2m
  - type: manual

consts:
  observation_window_minutes: 15
  baseline_window_minutes: 60
  spike_multiplier: 3
  tp_rate_drop_pct: 70
  cooldown_minutes: 5
  max_per_tick: 5

steps:
  # ── 1. Find fresh rule mutations that still need observation ─────────
  # Looser than the previous impl: drop the `mutation_op` filter because
  # seeded + backfilled snapshots are missing it. Require a real
  # `artifact_id` and `@timestamp` to be present. Exclude terminal states.
  # Respect the cooldown via a double must_not.
  - name: fresh_snapshots
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-snapshots"
      size: "{{ consts.max_per_tick }}"
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - terms: {artifact_type: ["rule", "detection_rule"]}
            - exists: {field: "artifact_id"}
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.observation_window_minutes }}m"
          must_not:
            - terms: {rollback_status: ["rolled_back", "clean", "regression_detected", "rollback_requested"]}
            - range:
                "last_evaluated_at":
                  gte: "now-{{ consts.cooldown_minutes }}m"
  - name: evaluate_snapshots
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.fresh_snapshots.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      - name: post_apply_alerts
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".alerts-security.alerts-*"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {"kibana.alert.rule.rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"

      - name: pre_apply_alerts
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".alerts-security.alerts-*"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {"kibana.alert.rule.rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}||-{{ consts.baseline_window_minutes }}m"
                      lt: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"

      # TP rate pre vs post. Concrete TP outcomes for THIS rule, not
      # "any TP in the system". Prevents false regressions on rules with
      # active TP flows (the bug in v1).
      - name: pre_tps
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".soc-outcomes"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {disposition: "true_positive"}
                - term: {"rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}||-{{ consts.baseline_window_minutes }}m"
                      lt: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"

      - name: post_tps
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: ".soc-outcomes"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: {disposition: "true_positive"}
                - term: {"rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"}
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"

      - name: write_decision
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-autonomy-decisions
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            rec_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id | default: 'unknown' }}"
            artifact_type: "rule"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
            snapshot_id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
            op: "rollback_observation"
            action: "{{ foreach.item._source.mutation_op | default: 'update' }}"
            source_agent: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            source_workflow: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            gates_evaluated: ["spike", "silence", "tp_drop"]
            gates_passed: "{% assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier %}{% assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult %}{% assign _spike = false %}{% if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 %}{% assign _spike = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _silence = false %}{% if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' %}{% assign _silence = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _tp_drop = false %}{% if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 %}{% assign _tp_drop = true %}{% endif %}[{% unless _spike %}\"spike\"{% endunless %}{% unless _silence %}{% unless _spike %},{% endunless %}\"silence\"{% endunless %}{% unless _tp_drop %}{% if _spike or _silence %}{% else %},{% endif %}\"tp_drop\"{% endunless %}]"
            final_status: "{% assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier %}{% assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult %}{% assign _spike = false %}{% if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 %}{% assign _spike = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _silence = false %}{% if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' %}{% assign _silence = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _tp_drop = false %}{% if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 %}{% assign _tp_drop = true %}{% endif %}{% if _pre == 0 and _pre_tp == 0 %}inconclusive{% elsif _spike and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% elsif _spike and _pre == 0 %}inconclusive{% else %}clean{% endif %}"
            auto_applied: false
            required_human: false
            review_reason: "pre_alerts={{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_alerts={{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} pre_tp={{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_tp={{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            confidence: 100

      # ── Write the structured observation record (fed by dashboards / KPI) ──
      - name: write_observation_record
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-post-apply-observations
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            snapshot_id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
            correlation_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id | default: 'unknown' }}"
            artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
            artifact_type: "rule"
            rule_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
            mutation_op: "{{ foreach.item._source.mutation_op | default: 'update' }}"
            source_agent: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            source_workflow: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            trust_tier: "{{ foreach.item._source.trust_tier | default: 'unknown' }}"
            window_minutes: "{{ consts.observation_window_minutes }}"
            applied_at: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"
            observed_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            pre_apply_alerts: "{{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            post_apply_alerts: "{{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            pre_apply_tps: "{{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            post_apply_tps: "{{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
            alert_spike_multiplier: "{%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- if _pre == 0 -%}0{%- else -%}{{ _post | divided_by: _pre }}{%- endif -%}"
            tp_delta: "{%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{{ _post_tp | minus: _pre_tp }}"
            gates_evaluated: ["spike", "silence", "tp_drop"]
            regression_detected: "{%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}{%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}{%- assign _spike = false -%}{%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _silence = false -%}{%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}{%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}{% if _spike and _tp_drop %}true{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
            rollback_triggered: "{%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}{%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}{%- assign _spike = false -%}{%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _silence = false -%}{%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}{%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _parent = foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id -%}{% if _spike and _tp_drop and _parent %}true{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop and _parent %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
            final_status: "{%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}{%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}{%- assign _spike = false -%}{%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _silence = false -%}{%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}{%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}{% if _pre == 0 and _pre_tp == 0 %}inconclusive{% elsif _spike and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% else %}clean{% endif %}"
            reason: "pre_alerts={{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_alerts={{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} pre_tp={{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_tp={{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} spike_multiplier_threshold={{ consts.spike_multiplier }}"

      # Always mark the snapshot with a verdict AND last_evaluated_at so
      # the cooldown filter on the next tick works. `observing` is the
      # non-terminal state used when we don't have enough data yet.
      - name: mark_snapshot_status
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: .soc-snapshots
          id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
          refresh: "wait_for"
          doc:
            rollback_status: "{% assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 %}{% assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier %}{% assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult %}{% assign _spike = false %}{% if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 %}{% assign _spike = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _silence = false %}{% if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' %}{% assign _silence = true %}{% endif %}{% assign _tp_drop = false %}{% if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 %}{% assign _tp_drop = true %}{% endif %}{% if _pre == 0 and _pre_tp == 0 %}observing{% elsif _spike and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}regression_detected{% else %}clean{% endif %}"
            last_evaluated_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"

      # Compute-and-match gate: did this snapshot exhibit a regression
      # (spike AND tp_drop) OR (silence AND tp_drop)?
      - name: gate_regression
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}
            {%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}
            {%- assign _spike = false -%}
            {%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _silence = false -%}
            {%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}
            {%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {% if _spike and _tp_drop %}yes{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

      # Compute-and-match gate: regression AND the snapshot has a parent_recommendation_id.
      - name: gate_regression_with_parent
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign _post = steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _pre = steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _pre_tp = steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _post_tp = steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign _mult = consts.spike_multiplier -%}
            {%- assign _pre_x = _pre | times: _mult -%}
            {%- assign _spike = false -%}
            {%- if _post > _pre_x and _pre > 0 -%}{%- assign _spike = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _silence = false -%}
            {%- if _post == 0 and _pre > 0 and foreach.item._source.mutation_op != 'disable' -%}{%- assign _silence = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _tp_drop = false -%}
            {%- if _pre_tp > 0 and _post_tp == 0 -%}{%- assign _tp_drop = true -%}{%- endif -%}
            {%- assign _parent = foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id -%}
            {% if _spike and _tp_drop and _parent %}yes{% elsif _silence and _tp_drop and _parent %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

      # Emit a rollback_mutation_intent. The applier picks it up like any
      # other mutation_intent -- deterministic track, status=auto_apply_ready
      # so it skips the backtester (a rollback is a revert, not a new change).
      - name: emit_rollback_intent
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-recommendations
          refresh: "wait_for"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            rec_id: "rollback-{{ foreach.item._id }}-{{ 'now' | date: '%s' }}"
            schema_version: "1.0"
            type: "mutation_intent"
            source: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            status: "auto_apply_ready"
            track: "deterministic"
            title: "Rollback rule {{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }} (regression detected by observer)"
            summary: "Observer detected post-apply regression (spike={{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} vs pre={{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}, tp_drop pre={{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post={{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}). Reverting to pre-apply snapshot."
            confidence: 95
            details:
              artifact_type: "rule"
              artifact_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
              op: "update"
              expected_ownership: "soc-post-apply-observer"
              reason: "observer_regression_rollback"
              parent_snapshot: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
              rollback_to: "{{ foreach.item._source.before | json }}"
            expected_impact:
              rollback: true
              restore_rule_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.artifact_id }}"
        if: "steps.gate_regression.output: yes"

      - name: close_intent_rolled_back
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: .soc-recommendations
          id: "{{ foreach.item._source.parent_recommendation_id }}"
          refresh: "wait_for"
          doc:
            status: rolled_back
            rolled_back_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            rolled_back_by: "soc-post-apply-observer"
            rollback_reason: "pre={{ steps.pre_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post={{ steps.post_apply_alerts.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} pre_tp={{ steps.pre_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} post_tp={{ steps.post_tps.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        if: "steps.gate_regression_with_parent.output: yes"

  # ── 3. Heartbeat ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: post_apply_observer_heartbeat
        source: "soc-post-apply-observer"
        snapshots_checked: "{{ steps.fresh_snapshots.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }}"
        version: "v2-rate-based"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Post-apply observer v2 tick complete — checked {{ steps.fresh_snapshots.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} fresh snapshots"

definition.name: SOC Post-Apply Observer
definition.description:
Rollback watchdog for autonomous mutations. Scheduled every 2 minutes. Compares post-apply behavior to the pre-apply baseline captured in `.soc-snapshots` and picks one of:

    clean              -> no regression detected, mark snapshot done
    regression         -> emit rollback_intent for applier to process
    inconclusive       -> not enough data; re-evaluate on the next tick

Guardrails against self-induced false positives:
  - A snapshot is only re-evaluated if `last_evaluated_at` is older than
    the cooldown OR missing entirely (prevents tight loops on the same
    snapshot when writes lag).
  - Regression requires BOTH an alert-volume anomaly (spike or silence)
    AND a TP-rate drop, not either alone. This avoids flagging every
    rule whose historical dataset contains TP outcomes as "regression".
  - Snapshots whose pre-apply sample is empty (no baseline) are flagged
    `inconclusive` and left observing, never regression.
  - Rollback is executed as a NEW rollback_mutation_intent posted to
    `.soc-recommendations`, processed by the existing applier machinery.
    There is exactly one place where rules are mutated: the applier.

Every observation (clean, regression, inconclusive) is logged to `.soc-autonomy-decisions` so the Autonomy Feed dashboard can show the closed loop.

results.name: SOC Caldera Poller
results.description:
Watches attack commands in .soc-attack-commands that the dispatcher has marked status=running, polls the Caldera REST API for each, and writes back techniques_executed / final status once the operation reaches a terminal state.
Companion workflow to soc-caldera-dispatcher. Together they replace the former caldera-bridge Python sidecar — the SOC simulation now drives Caldera entirely from native workflow steps (elasticsearch.*, http, foreach, if).
Terminal states per Caldera: finished, cleanup, paused. Anything else means still running; commands still running after 10 minutes (as seen by ES date math on claimed_at) are marked failed with reason=timeout.
results.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Caldera Poller
description: >
  Watches attack commands in .soc-attack-commands that the dispatcher has
  marked status=running, polls the Caldera REST API for each, and writes back
  techniques_executed / final status once the operation reaches a terminal state.

  Companion workflow to soc-caldera-dispatcher. Together they replace the
  former caldera-bridge Python sidecar — the SOC simulation now drives Caldera
  entirely from native workflow steps (elasticsearch.*, http, foreach, if).

  Terminal states per Caldera: finished, cleanup, paused. Anything else means
  still running; commands still running after 10 minutes (as seen by ES date
  math on claimed_at) are marked failed with reason=timeout.
enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 1m
  - type: manual

consts:
  # Caldera URL — Kibana runs from source on the host (after Bedrock temperature
  # platform fix), so the Docker-network hostname `caldera:8888` no longer resolves.
  # Use the OrbStack-forwarded port `localhost:18888` to match soc-caldera-dispatcher.
  # (Previously this was `http://caldera:8888`, which produced a steady stream of
  # ENOTFOUND errors — 46/53 failures in the last hour of 2026-04-17 soak.)
  caldera_url: "http://localhost:18888"
  caldera_api_key: "ADMIN123"
  timeout_minutes: 10

steps:
  # ── Pull running commands ────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: running_commands
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-attack-commands"
      size: 20
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: {status: "running"}
            - exists: {field: "caldera_operation_id"}

  # ── Pull commands that have been running for > timeout_minutes ──────
  # Kept as a separate query so timeout detection is done server-side via
  # ES date math (now-Xm), avoiding fragile Liquid timestamp arithmetic.
  - name: timed_out_commands
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: ".soc-attack-commands"
      size: 20
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: {status: "running"}
            - exists: {field: "caldera_operation_id"}
            - range:
                claimed_at:
                  lt: "now-10m"

  - name: poll
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.running_commands.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      - name: get_operation
        type: http
        with:
          url: "{{ consts.caldera_url }}/api/v2/operations/{{ foreach.item._source.caldera_operation_id }}"
          method: GET
          headers:
            KEY: "{{ consts.caldera_api_key }}"

      # Gate: is the Caldera operation in a terminal state?
      # Pre-compute to scalar "yes"/"no" so KQL `output: yes` can match.
      # IMPORTANT: http connector returns { status, statusText, headers, data }
      # so Caldera operation fields live under steps.get_operation.output.data.*
      - name: gate_terminal_state
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign s = steps.get_operation.output.data.state -%}
            {% if s == 'finished' or s == 'cleanup' or s == 'paused' %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

      # Terminal — finished/cleanup/paused: pull techniques from the chain.
      - name: mark_completed
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: ".soc-attack-commands"
          id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
          doc:
            status: "completed"
            completed_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            caldera_state: "{{ steps.get_operation.output.data.state }}"
            techniques_executed: "{{ steps.get_operation.output.data.chain | map: 'ability' | map: 'technique_id' | uniq | compact }}"
        if: "steps.gate_terminal_state.output: yes"

  # ── Timeout handling: separate foreach over the timed-out query ─────
  # Every command here is running > 10m AND not yet terminal (those get
  # rewritten above before this step runs). Still we gate on caldera_state
  # having been set to a non-terminal value in mark_completed above, but the
  # simplest correct rule is "if it's still in status=running after 10m, fail".
  - name: timeout
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.timed_out_commands.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      - name: mark_timeout
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: ".soc-attack-commands"
          id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
          doc:
            status: "failed"
            completed_at: "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            error: "Caldera operation did not terminate within {{ consts.timeout_minutes }} minutes"

  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: caldera_poller_tick
        running_count: "{{ steps.running_commands.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }}"
        timed_out_count: "{{ steps.timed_out_commands.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Caldera poller tick complete — inspected {{ steps.running_commands.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} running ops, marked {{ steps.timed_out_commands.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} as timed out"
